Repository: /Users/zhouhanru/Documents/David/Program/dev-cli (Go, Bubble Tea TUI in internal/tui, wired by internal/cli/tui.go). Search breadth: very thorough.

Goal: understand how the dashboard's REPOS tab is populated on first open and why rows visibly reorder while background data arrives. Specifically find and report (with file paths and line numbers, quoting key snippets):

1. The initial load sequence for the REPOS view: which Bubble Tea Init/Cmd(s) run, what data is loaded synchronously vs asynchronously (inventory/repo list, git status, repo SIZE via diskusage, LIVE Herdr/runtime status, LATEST commit time, worktree counts, tasks, favorites/stars).
2. The sort logic for REPOS rows: what the sort key is (favorites first? hot tasks? live runtime? latest activity? size?), where it's implemented, and when re-sorting happens (every message? after each async batch?). Identify why rows would jump around as herdr status / size / latest arrive incrementally.
3. How async results arrive: per-repo messages or batched? Is there throttling/debouncing? Is there a cache for size/latest/herdr (e.g. $XDG_CACHE_HOME/dev diskusage cache) and is it used before the fresh scan?
4. How the cursor/selection is preserved across re-sorts (by index or by repo identity?).
5. Any existing config knobs under [tui] or [tui.repos] for background refresh, sort order, size scanning, herdr polling.
6. Existing tests covering repos sorting / async updates in internal/tui.

Report concrete function names, message types, and the order of operations. Don't propose fixes, just report the mechanism.

```text
80	// Favorite is durable catalog intent, independent of observation freshness.
81	func (r RepoRow) Favorite() bool { return r.Asset != nil && r.Asset.Favorite }

89	// while remaining in the model's local snapshot for REMOTE matching.
90	func (r RepoRow) IsTry() bool {
91		return r.Asset != nil && r.Asset.Kind == catalog.KindTry && r.Asset.Experiment != nil &&
92			(r.Asset.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseActive || r.Asset.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseDeprecated)
93	}

95	func (r RepoRow) HotTasks() int {
96		n := 0
97		for _, t := range r.Tasks {
98			if t.State == task.Hot {
99				n++
100			}
101		}
102		return n
103	}

106	// which is what makes the list scannable at forty repositories.
107	func (r RepoRow) StateSummary() string {
108		if len(r.Tasks) == 0 {
109			return ""
110		}
111		counts := map[task.State]int{}
112		for _, t := range r.Tasks {
113			counts[t.State]++
114		}
115		var parts []string
116		for _, s := range task.States {
117			if counts[s] > 0 {
118				parts = append(parts, s.Icon()+strconv.Itoa(counts[s]))
119			}
120		}
121		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
122	}

124	// searchText is what a filter query matches against.
125	func (r RepoRow) searchText() string {
126		var b strings.Builder
127		b.WriteString(r.Repo.Display())
128		b.WriteString(" ")
129		b.WriteString(r.Status.Branch)
130		b.WriteString(" ")
131		b.WriteString(r.Topology.Summary())
132		for _, branch := range r.Topology.Branches {
133			b.WriteString(" ")
134			b.WriteString(branch.Branch)
135			b.WriteString(" ")
136			b.WriteString(branch.Upstream)
137		}
138		if r.Asset != nil {
139			b.WriteString(" ")
140			b.WriteString(string(r.Asset.Kind))
141			b.WriteString(" ")
142			b.WriteString(r.Asset.Note)
143			b.WriteString(" ")
144			b.WriteString(strings.Join(r.Asset.Tags, " "))
145		}
146		for _, t := range r.Tasks {
147			b.WriteString(" ")
148			b.WriteString(t.Title())
149			b.WriteString(" ")
150			b.WriteString(t.Branch)
151		}
152		for _, checkout := range r.Context.Checkouts {
153			b.WriteString(" ")
154			b.WriteString(checkout.Worktree.Path)
155			b.WriteString(" ")
156			b.WriteString(checkout.Branch())
157			b.WriteString(" ")
158			b.WriteString(string(checkout.Ownership))
159		}
160		return strings.ToLower(b.String())
161	}

163	func (r RepoRow) matches(query string) bool {
164		query = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(query))
165		for _, term := range strings.Fields(query) {
166			key, value, structured := strings.Cut(term, ":")
167			if structured {
168				switch key {
169				case "tag":
170					if r.Asset == nil || !r.Asset.HasTag(value) {
171						return false
172					}
173					continue
174				case "remote":
175					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(r.Topology.Summary()), value) {
176						return false
177					}
178					continue
179				case "size":
180					if !matchesSize(r.Usage, value) {
181						return false
182					}
183					continue
184				case "kind":
185					kind := catalog.KindRepository
186					if r.Asset != nil {
187						kind = r.Asset.Kind
188					}
189					if string(kind) != value {
190						return false
191					}
192					continue
193				}
194			}
195			if !strings.Contains(r.searchText(), term) {
196				return false
197			}
198		}
199		return true
200	}

214	// auth" — the order words come to mind in is rarely the order they appear in.
215	func matches(haystack, query string) bool {
216		return textmatch.Terms(haystack, query)
```

```text
1	package tui
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"fmt"
6		"slices"
7		"strings"
8	
9		tea "github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea"
10		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/diskusage"
11		"github.com/dustin/go-humanize"
12	)
13	
14	// SizeActions is the asynchronous disk-usage boundary injected by cli.runTUI.
15	type SizeActions struct {
16		Invalidate func(...diskusage.Target) error
17		Start      func(ctx context.Context, targets []diskusage.Target, force bool) diskusage.Load
18		Cancel     func(loadID uint64)
19	}
20	
21	type sizeMsg struct {
22		loadID uint64
23		result diskusage.Result
24		done   bool
25	}
26	
27	type sizeOwner struct {
28		key    string
29		loadID uint64
30	}
31	
32	func (m Model) updateSize(msg sizeMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
33		if msg.loadID == 0 {
34			return m, nil
35		}
36		load := m.sizeLoad
37		index := -1
38		if load.ID != msg.loadID {
39			for n, other := range m.scopedSizeLoads {
40				if other.ID == msg.loadID {
41					load, index = other, n
42					break
43				}
44			}
45			if index < 0 {
46				return m, nil
47			}
48		}
49		if msg.done {
50			if index < 0 {
51				m.sizeLoad = diskusage.Load{}
52			} else {
53				m.scopedSizeLoads = slices.Delete(slices.Clone(m.scopedSizeLoads), index, index+1)
54			}
55			return m, nil
56		}
57		for _, owner := range m.sizeOwners {
58			if owner.key == msg.result.Key && owner.loadID != msg.loadID {
59				return m, waitForSize(load)
60			}
61		}
62		m.applySizeResult(msg.result)
63		return m, waitForSize(load)
64	}
65	
66	func (m *Model) setSizeOwner(key string, id uint64) {
67		if key == "" {
68			return
69		}
70		m.sizeOwners = slices.Clone(m.sizeOwners)
71		for n := range m.sizeOwners {
72			if m.sizeOwners[n].key == key {
73				m.sizeOwners[n].loadID = id
74				return
75			}
76		}
77		m.sizeOwners = append(m.sizeOwners, sizeOwner{key, id})
78	}
79	
80	func (m Model) beginScopedSizes(targets, invalidated []diskusage.Target) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
81		for _, target := range invalidated {
82			m.setSizeOwner(target.Key, 0)
83		}
84		if m.actions.Sizes.Start == nil || len(targets) == 0 {
85			return m, nil
86		}
87		load := m.actions.Sizes.Start(m.baseContext(), targets, true)
88		if load.ID == 0 || load.Results == nil {
89			return m, nil
90		}
91		m.scopedSizeLoads = append(slices.Clone(m.scopedSizeLoads), load)
92		for _, target := range targets {
93			m.setSizeOwner(target.Key, load.ID)
94		}
95		return m, waitForSize(load)
96	}
97	
98	func (m Model) beginSizeLoad(force bool) (Model, tea.Cmd) {
99		if m.actions.Sizes.Start == nil {
100			return m, nil
101		}
102		if m.sizeLoad.ID != 0 && m.actions.Sizes.Cancel != nil {
103			m.actions.Sizes.Cancel(m.sizeLoad.ID)
104		}
105		for _, load := range m.scopedSizeLoads {
106			if m.actions.Sizes.Cancel != nil {
107				m.actions.Sizes.Cancel(load.ID)
108			}
109		}
110		m.scopedSizeLoads, m.sizeOwners = nil, nil
111		targets := make([]diskusage.Target, 0, len(m.repos)+len(m.tries))
112		for _, row := range m.repos {
113			if row.SizeTarget.Checkout != "" {
114				targets = append(targets, row.SizeTarget)
115			}
116		}
117		for _, row := range m.tries {
118			if row.SizeTarget.Checkout != "" {
119				targets = append(targets, row.SizeTarget)
120			}
121		}
122		m.sizeLoad = m.actions.Sizes.Start(m.baseContext(), targets, force)
123		if m.sizeLoad.ID == 0 || m.sizeLoad.Results == nil {
124			return m, nil
125		}
126		return m, waitForSize(m.sizeLoad)
127	}
128	
129	func waitForSize(load diskusage.Load) tea.Cmd {
130		return func() tea.Msg {
131			result, ok := <-load.Results
132			if !ok {
133				return sizeMsg{loadID: load.ID, done: true}
134			}
135			return sizeMsg{loadID: load.ID, result: result}
136		}
137	}
138	
139	func (m *Model) applySizeResult(result diskusage.Result) {
140		// Bubble Tea copies Model by value; clone slice headers before patching rows so
141		// two candidate models never share a mutated backing array.
142		m.repos = append([]RepoRow(nil), m.repos...)
143		m.tries = append([]TryRow(nil), m.tries...)
144		for index := range m.repos {
145			if m.repos[index].SizeTarget.Key != result.Key {
146				continue
147			}
148			if result.Err != nil {
149				m.repos[index].Usage, m.repos[index].SizeError = nil, result.Err
150			} else {
151				usage := result.Usage
152				m.repos[index].Usage, m.repos[index].SizeError = &usage, nil
153			}
154		}
155		for index := range m.tries {
156			if m.tries[index].SizeTarget.Key != result.Key {
157				continue
158			}
159			if result.Err != nil {
160				m.tries[index].Usage, m.tries[index].SizeError = nil, result.Err
161			} else {
162				usage := result.Usage
163				m.tries[index].Usage, m.tries[index].SizeError = &usage, nil
164			}
165		}
166	}
167	
168	func matchesSize(usage *diskusage.Usage, expression string) bool {
169		if usage == nil {
170			return false
171		}
172		expression = strings.TrimSpace(expression)
173		operator := "="
174		for _, candidate := range []string{">=", "<=", ">", "<", "="} {
175			if strings.HasPrefix(expression, candidate) {
176				operator = candidate
177				expression = strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(expression, candidate))
178				break
179			}
180		}
181		bytes, err := humanize.ParseBytes(expression)
182		if err != nil {
183			return false
184		}
185		owned := uint64(max(usage.OwnedBytes, 0))
186		switch operator {
187		case ">=":
188			return owned >= bytes
189		case "<=":
190			return owned <= bytes
191		case ">":
192			return owned > bytes
193		case "<":
194			return owned < bytes
195		default:
196			return owned == bytes
197		}
198	}
199	
200	func sizeDetailLines(usage *diskusage.Usage, err error, target diskusage.Target) []string {
201		if target.Checkout == "" {
202			return nil
203		}
204		if err != nil {
205			return []string{fmt.Sprintf("  %s  %s", styleDim.Render("size"), styleErr.Render(err.Error()))}
206		}
207		if usage == nil {
208			return []string{fmt.Sprintf("  %s  %s", styleDim.Render("size"), styleDim.Render("measuring…"))}
209		}
210		lines := []string{
211			fmt.Sprintf("  %s  %s logical owned", styleDim.Render("size"), usage.HumanOwned()),
212			fmt.Sprintf("  %s  %s", styleDim.Render("checkout"), humanize.IBytes(uint64(max(usage.CheckoutBytes, 0)))),
213		}
214		if usage.PrivateGitBytes != nil {
215			lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("  %s  %s", styleDim.Render("private .git"),
216				humanize.IBytes(uint64(max(*usage.PrivateGitBytes, 0)))))
217		}
218		if usage.SharedGitBytes != nil {
219			lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("  %s  %s (not reclaimable with this checkout)",
220				styleDim.Render("shared .git"), humanize.IBytes(uint64(max(*usage.SharedGitBytes, 0)))))
221		}
222		if !usage.Complete {
223			lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("  %s  partial; %d unreadable entries", styleDim.Render("measure"), usage.UnreadableEntries))
224		}
225		return lines
226	}
227	
228	func sizeCell(usage *diskusage.Usage, err error, target diskusage.Target) string {
229		switch {
230		case err != nil:
231			return "?"
232		case target.Checkout == "":
233			return "—"
234		case usage == nil:
235			return "…"
236		default:
237			value := usage.HumanOwned()
238			if usage.SharedGitBytes != nil {
239				value += "+S"
240			}
241			return value
242		}
243	}
```

```text
8	func mergeRepoProgress(previous, updates []RepoRow) []RepoRow {
9		rows := append([]RepoRow(nil), previous...)
10		for _, row := range updates {
11			found := false
12			for i, old := range rows {
13				if old.Repo.Path == row.Repo.Path || sameFavoriteRepository(old.Repo, row.Repo) {
14					if (row.Pending == "loading" && old.Pending != "loading" && old.Pending != "refreshing") ||
15						(row.Pending == "cached" && old.Pending != "cached" && old.Pending != "refreshing") {
16						if row.Asset != nil && (old.Asset == nil || !old.Asset.Updated.After(row.Asset.Updated)) {
17							rows[i].Asset = row.Asset.Clone()
18						}
19						found = true
20						break
21					}
22					if row.Asset == nil && (row.Pending == "loading" || row.Pending == "cached") && sameFavoriteRepository(old.Repo, row.Repo) {
23						row.Asset = old.Asset
24					}
25					if row.TopologyPending && !old.TopologyPending && old.Pending == "" {
26						row.Topology, row.TopologyErr, row.TopologyPending = old.Topology, old.TopologyErr, false
27					}
28					if row.Usage == nil {
29						row.Usage, row.SizeError = old.Usage, old.SizeError
30					}
31					rows[i] = row
32					found = true
33					break
34				}
35			}
36			if !found {
37				rows = append(rows, row)
38			}
39		}
40		return rows
41	}
42	
43	func (m Model) applyRepoProgress(result LocalResult) (Model, bool) {
44		state := m.viewLoad(ViewRepos)
45		if result.Generation != state.generation || m.repoProgressPhase == 3 {
46			return m, false
47		}
48		phase := 1
49		if result.Phase == "favorites" {
50			// Provisional intent can precede the cache without making the cache's
51			// other rows obsolete. Per-row merging protects richer observations.
52			phase = max(phase, m.repoProgressPhase)
53		} else if result.Phase != "cache" {
54			phase = 2
55		}
56		if phase < m.repoProgressPhase {
57			return m, false
58		}
59		m.repoProgressPhase = phase
60		token := m.currentToken()
61		path := m.repoFocusPath()
62		m.repos = mergeRepoProgress(m.repos, result.Repos)
63		m.loads[int(ViewRepos)].hasSnapshot = true
64		m.loads[int(ViewRepos)].freshness = perftrace.FreshnessStale
65		m.loads[int(ViewRepos)].actionable = false
66		m.loads[int(ViewRepos)].source = perftrace.SourceLive
67		if result.Phase == "cache" {
68			m.loads[int(ViewRepos)].source = perftrace.SourceCache
69		}
70		count := len(m.repos)
71		m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewSnapshotAccepted, perftrace.Fields{View: perftrace.ViewRepos, Stage: perftrace.StageFirstEnrichment, Source: m.loads[int(ViewRepos)].source, Freshness: perftrace.FreshnessStale, Generation: result.Generation, Rows: &count})
72		message := fmt.Sprintf("Refreshing local repositories… %d visible", count)
73		if result.Phase == "cache" && len(result.Repos) > 0 {
74			message = "Cached " + result.Repos[0].ObservedAt.Local().Format("Jan 2 15:04") + " · " + message
75		}
76		m.setViewStatus(ViewRepos, message)
77		m.restoreRepoFocus(token, path)
78		m.setAt(m.at())
79		return m, true
80	}
81	
82	func (m Model) repoFocusPath() string {
83		if item, ok := m.currentRepoItem(); ok {
84			if checkout, child := item.checkout(); child {
85				return checkout.Worktree.Path
86			}
87			return item.Repo.Repo.Path
88		}
89		return ""
90	}
91	func (m *Model) restoreRepoFocus(token selectionToken, path string) {
92		if m.selectToken(token) || m.view != ViewRepos || path == "" {
93			return
94		}
95		for i, item := range m.visibleRepoItems() {
96			candidate := item.Repo.Repo.Path
97			if checkout, child := item.checkout(); child {
98				candidate = checkout.Worktree.Path
99			}
100			if candidate == path {
101				m.setAt(i)
102				return
103			}
104		}
105	}
106	
107	func completeRepoRows(previous, rows []RepoRow) []RepoRow {
108		merged := mergeRepoProgress(previous, rows)
109		out := make([]RepoRow, 0, len(rows))
110		for _, row := range rows {
111			for _, candidate := range merged {
112				if row.Repo.Path == candidate.Repo.Path || sameFavoriteRepository(row.Repo, candidate.Repo) {
113					out = append(out, candidate)
114					break
115				}
116			}
117		}
118		return out
119	}
```

```text
509	// New builds the dashboard.
510	func New(actions Actions, rows []inventory.Row, repos []RepoRow) Model {
511		in := textinput.New()
512		in.CharLimit = 200
513		cloneSpinner := spinner.MiniDot
514		cloneSpinner.FPS = 200 * time.Millisecond
515	
516		m := Model{
517			actions:            actions,
518			rows:               rows,
519			repos:              repos,
520			input:              in,
521			remoteCloneSpinner: spinner.New(spinner.WithSpinner(cloneSpinner)),
522			width:              100,
523			height:             30,
524			firstViewReady:     make(chan struct{}),
525			firstViewOnce:      &sync.Once{},
526			fleetTree:          fleetTreeState{background: true, generation: 1, maxParallel: 4},
527			fleetWarmupAt:      time.Now().Add(5 * time.Second),
528		}
529		if len(actions.Tools) > 0 {
530			m.toolGeneration = 1
531		}
532		if rows != nil {
533			m.seedViewSnapshot(ViewTasks, perftrace.SourceLive, perftrace.FreshnessFresh, true)
534		}
535		if repos != nil {
536			m.seedViewSnapshot(ViewRepos, perftrace.SourceLive, perftrace.FreshnessFresh, true)
537		}
538		return m
539	}

610	func (m Model) Init() tea.Cmd {
611		if m.resumeInitial {
612			return batchCommands(m.resumeCommands...)
613		}
614		commands := []tea.Cmd{textinput.Blink}
615		if command := m.readStartupRepo(); command != nil {
616			commands = append(commands, command)
617		}
618		if m.initialLoad {
619			commands = append(commands, m.reload())
620		}
621		if len(m.actions.Tools) > 0 {
622			commands = append(commands, m.probeTools())
623		}
624		if m.actions.GHDash.Probe != nil {
625			commands = append(commands, m.probeGHDash())
626		}
627		if m.actions.LoadRemoteCache != nil {
628			commands = append(commands, m.loadRemoteCache())
629		}
630		if m.hostFleetEnabled() {
631			commands = append(commands, m.loadFleetHosts())
632			if m.fleetTree.background {
633				commands = append(commands, tea.Tick(max(0, time.Until(m.fleetWarmupAt)), func(time.Time) tea.Msg { return fleetWarmupMsg{} }))
634			}
635		} else if m.actions.LoadFleetCache != nil {
636			commands = append(commands, m.loadFleetCache())
637		}
638		if m.actions.AfterFirstView != nil {
639			commands = append(commands, m.runAfterFirstView())
640		}
641		if command := m.requestReleaseCheck(); command != nil {
642			commands = append(commands, command)
643		}
644		return tea.Batch(commands...)
645	}
```

```text
164		if m.overlay.registration != msg.sequence || m.overlay.kind != overlayActionMenu {
165			return m, nil
166		}
167		if msg.err != nil {
168			m.overlay = overlayState{}
169			m.err = msg.err
170			return m, nil
171		}
172		m.startupRepo.plan = msg.plan
173		p := msg.plan
174		body := fmt.Sprintf("Config: %q\nRepository: %q\n", p.File, p.RepoPath)
175		if p.Before != "" {
176			body += "Before:\n" + p.Before + "\n"
177		}
178		body += "After:\n" + p.After
179		if p.Field == string(repo.DiscoveryParent) {
180			body += "\nScans the parent and sibling projects using the normal depth-3 discovery rules."
181		} else {
182			body += "\nAdds only this repository to discovery."
183		}
184		o := overlayState{kind: overlayActionMenu, title: "review discovery configuration", subject: "Review the path before saving", body: body, registration: msg.sequence}
185		if p.Blocked != "" {
186			o.body += "\nManual edit required: " + p.Blocked + "\nPreserve existing entries when adding the path."
187			if m.actions.EditConfig != nil {
188				o.addOption(listActionRegistrationEdit, "open configuration in editor")
189			}
190		} else if m.actions.Discovery.Apply != nil {
191			o.addOption(listActionRegistrationConfirm, "confirm and save")
192		}
193		o.addOption(listActionRegistrationCancel, "cancel")
194		m.overlay = o
195		return m, nil
196	}
```

```text
     8	func mergeRepoProgress(previous, updates []RepoRow) []RepoRow {
     9		rows := append([]RepoRow(nil), previous...)
    10		for _, row := range updates {
    11			found := false
    12			for i, old := range rows {
    13				if old.Repo.Path == row.Repo.Path || sameFavoriteRepository(old.Repo, row.Repo) {
    14					if (row.Pending == "loading" && old.Pending != "loading" && old.Pending != "refreshing") ||
    15						(row.Pending == "cached" && old.Pending != "cached" && old.Pending != "refreshing") {
    16						if row.Asset != nil && (old.Asset == nil || !old.Asset.Updated.After(row.Asset.Updated)) {
    17							rows[i].Asset = row.Asset.Clone()
    18						}
    19						found = true
    20						break
    21					}
    22					if row.Asset == nil && (row.Pending == "loading" || row.Pending == "cached") && sameFavoriteRepository(old.Repo, row.Repo) {
    23						row.Asset = old.Asset
    24					}
    25					if row.TopologyPending && !old.TopologyPending && old.Pending == "" {
    26						row.Topology, row.TopologyErr, row.TopologyPending = old.Topology, old.TopologyErr, false
    27					}
    28					if row.Usage == nil {
    29						row.Usage, row.SizeError = old.Usage, old.SizeError
    30					}
    31					rows[i] = row
    32					found = true
    33					break
    34				}
    35			}
    36			if !found {
    37				rows = append(rows, row)
    38			}
    39		}
    40		return rows
    41	}
    42	
    43	func (m Model) applyRepoProgress(result LocalResult) (Model, bool) {
    44		state := m.viewLoad(ViewRepos)
    45		if result.Generation != state.generation || m.repoProgressPhase == 3 {
    46			return m, false
    47		}
    48		phase := 1
    49		if result.Phase == "favorites" {
    50			// Provisional intent can precede the cache without making the cache's
    51			// other rows obsolete. Per-row merging protects richer observations.
    52			phase = max(phase, m.repoProgressPhase)
    53		} else if result.Phase != "cache" {
    54			phase = 2
    55		}
    56		if phase < m.repoProgressPhase {
    57			return m, false
    58		}
    59		m.repoProgressPhase = phase
    60		token := m.currentToken()
    61		path := m.repoFocusPath()
    62		m.repos = mergeRepoProgress(m.repos, result.Repos)
    63		m.loads[int(ViewRepos)].hasSnapshot = true
    64		m.loads[int(ViewRepos)].freshness = perftrace.FreshnessStale
    65		m.loads[int(ViewRepos)].actionable = false
    66		m.loads[int(ViewRepos)].source = perftrace.SourceLive
    67		if result.Phase == "cache" {
    68			m.loads[int(ViewRepos)].source = perftrace.SourceCache
    69		}
    70		count := len(m.repos)
    71		m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewSnapshotAccepted, perftrace.Fields{View: perftrace.ViewRepos, Stage: perftrace.StageFirstEnrichment, Source: m.loads[int(ViewRepos)].source, Freshness: perftrace.FreshnessStale, Generation: result.Generation, Rows: &count})
    72		message := fmt.Sprintf("Refreshing local repositories… %d visible", count)
    73		if result.Phase == "cache" && len(result.Repos) > 0 {
    74			message = "Cached " + result.Repos[0].ObservedAt.Local().Format("Jan 2 15:04") + " · " + message
    75		}
    76		m.setViewStatus(ViewRepos, message)
    77		m.restoreRepoFocus(token, path)
    78		m.setAt(m.at())
    79		return m, true
    80	}
    81	
    82	func (m Model) repoFocusPath() string {
    83		if item, ok := m.currentRepoItem(); ok {
    84			if checkout, child := item.checkout(); child {
    85				return checkout.Worktree.Path
    86			}
    87			return item.Repo.Repo.Path
    88		}
    89		return ""
    90	}
    91	func (m *Model) restoreRepoFocus(token selectionToken, path string) {
    92		if m.selectToken(token) || m.view != ViewRepos || path == "" {
    93			return
    94		}
    95		for i, item := range m.visibleRepoItems() {
    96			candidate := item.Repo.Repo.Path
    97			if checkout, child := item.checkout(); child {
    98				candidate = checkout.Worktree.Path
    99			}
   100			if candidate == path {
   101				m.setAt(i)
   102				return
   103			}
   104		}
   105	}
   106	
   107	func completeRepoRows(previous, rows []RepoRow) []RepoRow {
   108		merged := mergeRepoProgress(previous, rows)
   109		out := make([]RepoRow, 0, len(rows))
   110		for _, row := range rows {
   111			for _, candidate := range merged {
   112				if row.Repo.Path == candidate.Repo.Path || sameFavoriteRepository(row.Repo, candidate.Repo) {
   113					out = append(out, candidate)
   114					break
   115				}
   116			}
   117		}
   118		return out
   119	}
```

```text
754		model := tui.New(actions, nil, nil).WithTrace(app.trace).WithContext(uiCtx).WithFleetBackgroundRefresh(app.Cfg.TUI.Fleet.BackgroundRefresh).WithSSHBackgroundRefresh(app.Cfg.TUI.SSH.BackgroundRefresh).BeginLoading()

758		var final tea.Model
759		var err error
760		for {
761			final, err = tea.NewProgram(model, tea.WithAltScreen(), tea.WithMouseCellMotion()).Run()
762			cancelUI()
763			if err != nil {
764				break
765			}
766			finished, ok := final.(tui.Model)
767			if !ok {
768				err = errors.New("dashboard returned an invalid model")
769				break
770			}
771			if handoffErr := finished.TerminalHandoffError(); handoffErr != nil {
772				err = handoffErr
773				break
774			}
775			handoff := finished.FleetHandoff()
776			if handoff == nil {
777				break
778			}
779			// A fresh Program owns a fresh input decoder. Merely suspending an old
780			// Program can replay already-decoded Enter keys after native completion.
781			result, runErr := handoff.Run(runCtx, app.In, app.Out, app.Err)
782			uiCtx, cancelUI = context.WithCancel(runCtx)
783			model = finished.ResumeFleetHandoff(uiCtx, result, runErr)
784			if handoffErr := model.TerminalHandoffError(); handoffErr != nil {
785				cancelUI()
786				err = handoffErr
787				break
788			}
789		}
790		cancelRun()
791		app.finishTrace()
792		if err != nil {
793			return err
794		}
795		// A directory choice can only be honoured once the alternate screen is
796		// torn down, and only by the shell wrapper.
797		if m, ok := final.(tui.Model); ok {
798			if handoff := m.AfterExit(); handoff != nil {
799				return handoff()
800			}
801			if dir := m.Chosen(); dir != "" {
802				return app.cdDirective(dir)

804			if handle := m.Activation(); handle != "" {
805				rt, resolveErr := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctxOf())
806				if resolveErr != nil {
807					return resolveErr
808				}
809				return activateRuntime(ctxOf(), rt, handle)

813	}
```

```text
1284	// flight to the top — that is what someone opening the dashboard is looking

1286	func (m Model) visibleRepos() []RepoRow {
1287		var out []RepoRow
1288		for _, r := range m.repos {
1289			r = m.withRepoFavorite(r)

1291				continue
1292			}

1296		if sortBy == "" {
1297			sortBy = "activity"
1298		}

1300			cmp := compareRepos(out[i], out[j], sortBy)
1301			if m.actions.RepoReverse {

1309	}

1342	// visibleRepoItems flattens expanded worktrees under their sorted parent.
1343	// Children never participate in repo sorting and therefore cannot drift away
1344	// from the repository they belong to.
1345	func (m Model) visibleRepoItems() []repoItem {
1346		repos := m.visibleRepos()

1352			}

1354				out = append(out, repoItem{Repo: r, CheckoutIndex: i})
1355			}
1356		}
1357		return out
1358	}
```

```text
1612	// compareRepos returns negative when a belongs before b.
1613	func compareRepos(a, b RepoRow, sortBy string) int {
1614		nameCmp := strings.Compare(strings.ToLower(a.Repo.Display()), strings.ToLower(b.Repo.Display()))
1615		descInt := func(x, y int) int {
1616			switch {
1617			case x > y:
1618				return -1
1619			case x < y:
1620				return 1
1621			default:
1622				return 0
1623			}
1624		}
1625		descBool := func(x, y bool) int {
1626			if x == y {
1627				return 0
1628			}
1629			if x {
1630				return -1
1631			}
1632			return 1
1633		}
1634		latest := func() int {
1635			if a.LastActivity.Equal(b.LastActivity) {
1636				return 0
1637			}
1638			if a.LastActivity.After(b.LastActivity) {
1639				return -1
1640			}
1641			return 1
1642		}
1643	
1644		switch sortBy {
1645		case "name":
1646			return nameCmp
1647		case "latest":
1648			if c := latest(); c != 0 {
1649				return c
1650			}
1651		case "git":
1652			if c := descBool(a.Status.Dirty(), b.Status.Dirty()); c != 0 {
1653				return c
1654			}
1655			if c := descInt(a.Status.Changed, b.Status.Changed); c != 0 {
1656				return c
1657			}
1658		case "size":
1659			switch {
1660			case a.Usage != nil && b.Usage == nil:
1661				return -1
1662			case a.Usage == nil && b.Usage != nil:
1663				return 1
1664			case a.Usage != nil && b.Usage != nil && a.Usage.OwnedBytes > b.Usage.OwnedBytes:
1665				return -1
1666			case a.Usage != nil && b.Usage != nil && a.Usage.OwnedBytes < b.Usage.OwnedBytes:
1667				return 1
1668			}
1669		case "tasks":
1670			if c := descInt(a.HotTasks(), b.HotTasks()); c != 0 {
1671				return c
1672			}
1673			if c := descInt(len(a.Tasks), len(b.Tasks)); c != 0 {
1674				return c
1675			}
1676		default: // activity
1677			if c := descInt(a.HotTasks(), b.HotTasks()); c != 0 {
1678				return c
1679			}
1680			if c := descBool(a.Live, b.Live); c != 0 {
1681				return c
1682			}
1683			if c := descBool(a.Status.Dirty(), b.Status.Dirty()); c != 0 {
1684				return c
1685			}
1686			if c := descInt(len(a.Tasks), len(b.Tasks)); c != 0 {
1687				return c
1688			}
1689			if c := latest(); c != 0 {
1690				return c
1691			}
1692		}
1693		return nameCmp
1694	}
1695	
1696	func containsState(list []task.State, s task.State) bool {
1697		for _, v := range list {
1698			if v == s {
1699				return true
1700			}
1701		}
1702		return false
1703	}
```

```text
32	// collectTUIRepoStream owns admission, deduplication and publication. Only one
33	// cancellable permit request is outstanding; there is never a goroutine per
34	// queued repository. A slow favorite occupies its own slot, not a phase barrier.
35	func collectTUIRepoStream(ctx context.Context, metadata tuiRepoCatalog, repositories *tuiFuture[[]repo.Repo], live *tuiFuture[tuiRuntimeSnapshot], limiter *inventory.Limiter,
36		validate func(context.Context, repo.Repo) (repo.Repo, error), collect func(context.Context, tui.RepoRow) tui.RepoRow,
37		tasksErr error, publish func(string, tui.RepoRow)) ([]tui.RepoRow, error) {
38		var records []tuiRepoRecord
39		var favorites, ordinary []tuiRepoJob
40		reserved := map[string]int{}
41		known := map[string]bool{}
42		owners := map[string]int{}
43		for _, row := range metadata.seeds {
44			index := len(records)
45			records = append(records, tuiRepoRecord{row: row})
46			favorites = append(favorites, tuiRepoJob{index: index, validate: true, row: row})
47			for _, key := range tuiRepoKeys(row.Repo) {
48				reserved[key]++
49			}
50		}
51		var pending []repo.Repo
52		admitDiscovered := func() {
53			waiting := pending[:0]
54			for _, r := range pending {
55				keys := tuiRepoKeys(r)
56				duplicate, held := false, false
57				for _, key := range keys {
58					duplicate = duplicate || known[key]
59					held = held || reserved[key] > 0
60				}
61				if duplicate {
62					for _, key := range keys {
63						if known[key] {
64							owner := owners[key]
65							if preferTUIRepoAlias(&records[owner].row, r) && records[owner].complete {
66								publish("enrichment", records[owner].row)
67							}
68							break
69						}
70					}
71					continue
72				}
73				if held {
74					waiting = append(waiting, r)
75					continue
76				}
77				row := tui.RepoRow{Repo: r, Asset: metadata.asset(r)}
78				job := tuiRepoJob{index: len(records), row: row}
79				records = append(records, tuiRepoRecord{row: row})
80				for _, key := range keys {
81					known[key], owners[key] = true, job.index
82				}
83				if row.Favorite() {
84					favorites = append(favorites, job)
85				} else {

87				}
88			}
89			pending = waiting
90		}

93		permits := make(chan func())
94		var workers sync.WaitGroup

100		var runtimeSnapshot tuiRuntimeSnapshot
101		var runtimeErr error
102		runtimeDone := false
103		join := func(row *tui.RepoRow) {
104			row.Context.TaskErr = tasksErr

106				return
107			}
108			row.Pending = "runtime pending"
109			if runtimeDone {
110				if runtimeErr != nil {
111					row.Context.RuntimeErr = runtimeErr
112					row.Pending = "runtime unavailable"
113				} else {

115					row.Pending = ""
116				}
117			}
118			if row.Favorite() && row.Repo.HasGit && !row.Repo.Bare && !row.GitKnown {
119				// Status failure is not proof that this navigation target disappeared.
120				// Keep observation-dependent actions pending; open revalidates identity.
121				row.Pending = "Git observation unavailable"

123		}

126				return nil, errors.Join(err, ctx.Err())
127			}

129				acquiring = true

131					release, ok := limiter.Acquire(workerCtx)

134					}

137					case <-workerCtx.Done():

139					}
140				})
141			}

143				break
144			}
145			select {

150				err = errors.Join(err, repositories.err)
151				pending = append(pending, repositories.value...)

153			case <-runtimeReady:
154				runtimeReady, runtimeDone = nil, true
155				runtimeSnapshot, runtimeErr = live.value, live.err
156				err = errors.Join(err, runtimeErr)
157				for i := range records {

159						join(&records[i].row)

163			case release := <-permits:

193							}

196						}
197					} else {

202					case <-workerCtx.Done():
203					}
204				})
205			case result := <-completed:
206				if result.proceed == nil {
207					active--
208				}
209				index, row := result.job.index, result.row
210				if result.job.validate {
211					for _, key := range tuiRepoKeys(result.job.row.Repo) {
212						reserved[key]--
213					}
214					if result.err != nil {
215						row = result.job.row

232							active--
233							result.proceed <- false
234						} else {

236								known[key], owners[key] = true, index
237							}
238							records[index].row = row
239							result.proceed <- true
240						}
241					}

243					continue
244				}
245				if row.Favorite() && row.Repo.HasGit && !row.Repo.Bare && !row.GitKnown {
246					reason := "repository Git observation unavailable"
247					if main, ok := row.Context.Main(); ok && main.StatusErr != nil {
248						reason = main.StatusErr.Error()
249					}

251				}

253				join(&row)
```

```text
10	// LocalLoadRequest identifies the three view generations sharing one source
11	// snapshot. Each result remains independently replaceable.
12	type LocalLoadRequest struct {
13		CycleGeneration uint64
14		TasksGeneration uint64
15		ReposGeneration uint64
16		TriesGeneration uint64
17		ShowAllTries    bool
18		ForceSizes      bool
19	}
20	
21	// LocalResult is one terminal TASKS, REPOS, or TRY snapshot.
22	type LocalResult struct {
23		Phase      string
24		View       View
25		Generation uint64
26		Tasks      []inventory.Row
27		Repos      []RepoRow
28		Tries      []TryRow
29		Valid      bool
30		Err        error
31	}
32	
33	// LocalLoad is a cancellable stream owned by the caller's context.
34	type LocalLoad struct {
35		ID      uint64
36		Request LocalLoadRequest
37		Results <-chan LocalResult
38	}
39	
40	// LocalActions starts one shared local source cycle.
41	type LocalActions struct {
42		Start func(context.Context, LocalLoadRequest) LocalLoad
43	}
44	
45	type localMsg struct {
46		load   LocalLoad
47		result LocalResult
48		done   bool
49	}
50	
51	func (m Model) startLocalLoad() tea.Cmd {
52		if m.actions.Local.Start == nil {
53			return nil
54		}
55		request := LocalLoadRequest{
56			CycleGeneration: m.localGeneration,
57			TasksGeneration: m.viewLoad(ViewTasks).generation,
58			ReposGeneration: m.viewLoad(ViewRepos).generation,
59			TriesGeneration: m.viewLoad(ViewTries).generation,
60			ShowAllTries:    m.showAllTries,
61			ForceSizes:      m.forceSizeReload,
62		}
63		load := m.actions.Local.Start(m.localReadContext(), request)
64		load.Request = request
65		if load.ID == 0 || load.Results == nil {
66			return nil
67		}
68		return waitForLocal(load)
69	}
70	
71	func waitForLocal(load LocalLoad) tea.Cmd {
72		return func() tea.Msg {
73			result, ok := <-load.Results
74			if !ok {
75				return localMsg{load: load, done: true}
76			}
77			return localMsg{load: load, result: result}
78		}
79	}
80	
81	func (m Model) applyLocalResult(result LocalResult) (Model, bool) {
82		accepted := false
83		if result.View == ViewRepos && result.Phase != "" {
84			return m.applyRepoProgress(result)
85		}
86		token := m.currentToken()
87		path := m.repoFocusPath()
88		switch result.View {
89		case ViewTasks:
90			accepted = m.applyViewResult(
91				ViewTasks, result.Generation, result.Valid, "live", resultFreshness(result.Err),
92				len(result.Tasks), result.Err, result.Valid,
93			)
94			if accepted && result.Valid {
95				m.rows = append([]inventory.Row(nil), result.Tasks...)
96			}
97		case ViewRepos:
98			accepted = m.applyViewResult(
99				ViewRepos, result.Generation, result.Valid, "live", resultFreshness(result.Err),
100				len(result.Repos), result.Err, result.Valid,
101			)
102			if accepted && result.Valid {
103				m.setViewStatus(ViewRepos, "")
104				m.acceptCompleteRepoSnapshot(result.Err)
105				if result.Err != nil {
106					m.repos = mergeRepoProgress(m.repos, result.Repos)
107				} else {
108					m.repos = completeRepoRows(m.repos, result.Repos)
109				}
110				m.repoProgressPhase = 3
111				m.matchRemoteLocals()
112			}
113		case ViewTries:
114			accepted = m.applyViewResult(
115				ViewTries, result.Generation, result.Valid, "live", resultFreshness(result.Err),
116				len(result.Tries), result.Err, result.Valid,
117			)
118			if accepted && result.Valid {
119				m.tries = append([]TryRow(nil), result.Tries...)
120				m.matchRemoteLocals()
121			}
122		}
123		m.restoreRepoFocus(token, path)
124		m.setAt(m.at())
125		return m, accepted
126	}
```

```text
   315	func joinRuntime(row *tui.RepoRow, live tuiRuntimeSnapshot) {

   322		row.RuntimeHandle = ""
   323		row.RuntimeStatus = ""
   324		row.Runtime = name
```

```text
    20	func prepareRepoRowCollector(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, options repoCollectOptions) (func(context.Context, tui.RepoRow) tui.RepoRow, error) {

     1	package cli
     2	
     3	import (
     4		"context"
     5		"errors"
     6		"fmt"
     7		"os"
     8		"path/filepath"
     9		"strings"
    10	
    11		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/catalog"
    12		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/gitx"
    13		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/repo"
    14		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/tui"
    15	)
    16	
    17	// Preferences are read from the durable catalog, never from the observation
    18	// cache. This snapshot is read-only and scoped to one load generation.
    19	type tuiRepoCatalog struct {
    20		entries []*catalog.Entry
    21		seeds   []tui.RepoRow
    22		host    string
    23	}
    24	
    25	func readTUIRepoCatalog(ctx context.Context, app *App) (tuiRepoCatalog, error) {
    26		out := tuiRepoCatalog{host: configHostname()}
    27		if app.Catalog == nil {
    28			return out, nil
    29		}
    30		entries, diagnostics, err := app.Catalog.ListWithDiagnostics()
    31		if err != nil {
    32			return out, fmt.Errorf("catalog metadata: %w", err)
    33		}
    34		out.entries = entries
    35		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
    36			err = errors.Join(err, diagnostic)
    37		}
    38		claimed := map[string]string{}
    39		for _, entry := range entries {
    40			location, ok := entry.LocationFor(out.host)
    41			if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent {
    42				continue
    43			}
    44			for _, key := range tuiRepoKeys(repo.Repo{Path: location.CurrentPath, RealPath: location.RealPath, CommonDir: location.GitCommonDir}) {
    45				if owner := claimed[key]; owner != "" && owner != entry.ID {
    46					err = errors.Join(err, fmt.Errorf("catalog assets %s and %s match the same local repository", owner, entry.ID))
    47				} else {
    48					claimed[key] = entry.ID
    49				}
    50			}
    51		}
    52		for _, entry := range entries {
    53			if ctx.Err() != nil {
    54				return out, errors.Join(err, ctx.Err())
    55			}
    56			if !entry.Favorite || entry.Kind != catalog.KindRepository {
    57				continue
    58			}
    59			location, ok := entry.LocationFor(out.host)
    60			if !ok || location.CurrentPath == "" {
    61				continue
    62			}
    63			for _, root := range app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots() {
    64				covered, scopeErr := repo.PathDiscoverableFromRoot(root, location.CurrentPath, repo.DefaultOptions())
    65				if scopeErr != nil {
    66					err = errors.Join(err, fmt.Errorf("favorite %s discovery scope: %w", entry.Title(), scopeErr))
    67					continue
    68				}
    69				if !covered {
    70					continue
    71				}
    72				category := ""
    73				if relative, relErr := filepath.Rel(root, location.CurrentPath); relErr == nil && relative != ".." && !strings.HasPrefix(relative, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)) {
    74					category = filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(relative))
    75					if category == "." {
    76						category = ""
    77					}
    78				}
    79				out.seeds = append(out.seeds, tui.RepoRow{
    80					Repo: repo.Repo{Name: filepath.Base(location.CurrentPath), Path: location.CurrentPath,
    81						RealPath: location.RealPath, CommonDir: location.GitCommonDir,
    82						Root: root, Category: category, HasGit: location.GitCommonDir != ""},
    83					Asset: entry.Clone(), Pending: "loading",
    84				})
    85				break
    86			}
    87		}
    88		return out, err
    89	}
    90	
    91	func (c tuiRepoCatalog) asset(repository repo.Repo) *catalog.Entry {
    92		var match *catalog.Entry
    93		for _, entry := range c.entries {
    94			location, ok := entry.LocationFor(c.host)
    95			if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent || !repoLocationMatches(repository, location) {
    96				continue
    97			}
    98			if match != nil {
    99				// Ambiguous metadata must not acquire authority through discovery.
   100				return nil
   101			}
   102			match = entry
   103		}
   104		if match == nil {
   105			return nil
   106		}
   107		return match.Clone()
   108	}
   109	
   110	func discoverTUIFavorite(ctx context.Context, expected repo.Repo) (repo.Repo, error) {
   111		if _, err := repo.ValidateNavigation(ctx, expected, ""); err != nil {
   112			return expected, err
   113		}
   114		g, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, expected.Path)
   115		if err != nil {
   116			if !expected.HasGit && errors.Is(err, gitx.ErrNotARepo) {
   117				// A failed Git marker is not an explicitly observed plain directory.
   118				if _, markerErr := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(expected.Path, ".git")); os.IsNotExist(markerErr) {
   119					expected.RealPath = canonicalRepoValue(expected.Path)
   120					return expected, nil
   121				}
   122			}
   123			// Discover's --show-toplevel is rejected by bare hubs. Navigation has
   124			// already checked the expected identity; obtain the actual bare fields
   125			// with Git rather than accepting a filesystem skeleton as authority.
   126			out, bareErr := gitx.RunReadOnly(ctx, expected.Path, "rev-parse", "--path-format=absolute", "--git-dir", "--git-common-dir", "--is-bare-repository")
   127			fields := strings.Split(strings.TrimSpace(out), "\n")
   128			if bareErr != nil || len(fields) != 3 || fields[2] != "true" {
   129				return expected, err
   130			}
   131			g.GitDir, g.GitCommonDir = canonicalRepoValue(fields[0]), canonicalRepoValue(fields[1])
   132			if g.GitDir == "" || g.GitCommonDir == "" {
   133				return expected, err
   134			}
   135			g.MainRoot, g.Bare = g.GitCommonDir, true
   136		}
   137		if !expected.HasGit && !g.Bare && canonicalRepoValue(expected.Path) != g.Root {
   138			// Preserve an observed plain directory below another repository; Git's
   139			// ancestor lookup must not silently change which target this row means.
   140			expected.RealPath = canonicalRepoValue(expected.Path)
   141			return expected, nil
   142		}
   143		if g.IsLinkedWorktree {
   144			return expected, errors.New("favorite target is a linked worktree, not a repository root")
   145		}
   146		expected.RealPath, expected.GitDir, expected.CommonDir = g.MainRoot, g.GitDir, g.GitCommonDir
   147		expected.MainRoot, expected.HasGit, expected.Bare = g.MainRoot, true, g.Bare
   148		if info, statErr := os.Lstat(expected.Path); statErr == nil {
   149			expected.Symlink = info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0
   150		}
   151		return expected, nil
   152	}
   153	
   154	// A targeted physical-path seed must not erase the human navigation alias
   155	// chosen by discovery. Presentation changes do not repeat Git enrichment.
   156	func preferTUIRepoAlias(row *tui.RepoRow, alias repo.Repo) bool {
   157		if !alias.Symlink || row.Repo.Symlink {
   158			return false
   159		}
   160		row.Repo.Path, row.Repo.Name = alias.Path, alias.Name
   161		row.Repo.Root, row.Repo.Category, row.Repo.Symlink = alias.Root, alias.Category, true
   162		if row.Context.Repo.Path != "" {
   163			row.Context.Repo = row.Repo
   164		}
   165		return true
   166	}
   167	
   168	// Keys use physical paths and Git common directories, never display names.
   169	// Seed keys reserve only potentially matching work until target validation;
   170	// only freshly validated keys authorize deduplication of enrichment.
   171	func tuiRepoKeys(r repo.Repo) []string {
   172		var keys []string
   173		if common := canonicalRepoValue(r.CommonDir); common != "" {
   174			keys = append(keys, "git:"+common)
   175		}
   176		for path := range canonicalRepoValues(r.Path, r.RealPath) {
   177			keys = append(keys, "path:"+path)
   178		}
   179		return keys
   180	}
```

```text
1613	func compareRepos(a, b RepoRow, sortBy string) int {
1614		nameCmp := strings.Compare(strings.ToLower(a.Repo.Display()), strings.ToLower(b.Repo.Display()))
1615		descInt := func(x, y int) int {
1616			switch {
1617			case x > y:
1618				return -1
1619			case x < y:
1620				return 1
1621			default:
1622				return 0
1623			}
1624		}
1625		descBool := func(x, y bool) int {
1626			if x == y {
1627				return 0
1628			}
1629			if x {
1630				return -1
1631			}
1632			return 1
1633		}
1634		latest := func() int {
1635			if a.LastActivity.Equal(b.LastActivity) {
1636				return 0
1637			}
1638			if a.LastActivity.After(b.LastActivity) {
1639				return -1
1640			}
1641			return 1
1642		}
1643	
1644		switch sortBy {
1645		case "name":
1646			return nameCmp
1647		case "latest":
1648			if c := latest(); c != 0 {
1649				return c
1650			}
1651		case "git":
1652			if c := descBool(a.Status.Dirty(), b.Status.Dirty()); c != 0 {
1653				return c
1654			}
1655			if c := descInt(a.Status.Changed, b.Status.Changed); c != 0 {
1656				return c
1657			}
1658		case "size":
1659			switch {
1660			case a.Usage != nil && b.Usage == nil:
1661				return -1
1662			case a.Usage == nil && b.Usage != nil:
1663				return 1
1664			case a.Usage != nil && b.Usage != nil && a.Usage.OwnedBytes > b.Usage.OwnedBytes:
1665				return -1
1666			case a.Usage != nil && b.Usage != nil && a.Usage.OwnedBytes < b.Usage.OwnedBytes:
1667				return 1
1668			}
1669		case "tasks":

1688			}
1689			if c := latest(); c != 0 {
1690				return c
1691			}
1692		}
1693		return nameCmp
1694	}
```

```text
67		m.prepareRepoDependentForReload(ViewFleet, !m.hostFleetEnabled() && m.actions.ReloadFleetWithRepos != nil)

72	func (m *Model) prepareRepoDependentForReload(view View, enabled bool) {
73		if !enabled {
74			return
75		}
76		state := m.viewLoad(view)
77		switch {
78		case state.loading || m.view == view:
79			m.beginViewLoad(view, loadRefresh)
80			m.setViewStatus(view, "waiting for local repositories…")
81		case state.hasSnapshot:
82			m.invalidateView(view)
83		}
84	}
85	
86	func (m *Model) beginViewLoad(view View, cause loadCause) uint64 {
87		if view == ViewRemote {
88			m.remoteMetrics.cancelLoad()
89		}
90		if view == ViewRepos {
91			m.repoProgressPhase = 0
92			m.topologyRequested = nil
93			m.repos = append([]RepoRow(nil), m.repos...)
94			for i := range m.repos {
95				m.repos[i].Pending = "refreshing"
96			}
97			m.prepareRepoDependentsForReload()
98		}
99		index := int(view)
100		if cancel := m.loadCancels[index]; cancel != nil {
101			cancel()
102		}
103		ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(m.baseContext())
104		m.loadContexts[index] = ctx
105		m.loadCancels[index] = cancel
106		if view == ViewRepos && m.remoteClone.phase == remoteCloneRefreshing {
107			// A newer REPOS generation may supersede the clone-triggered refresh.
108			// Cancellation must always follow the generation that can complete it.
109			m.remoteClone.cancel = cancel
110		}
111		state := &m.loads[index]
112		state.generation++
113		state.cause = cause
114		state.requested = true
115		state.loading = true
116		state.outcome = ""
117		m.viewErrors[int(view)] = nil
118		m.viewStatuses[int(view)] = ""
119		m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewLoadRequested, perftrace.Fields{
120			View: view.traceView(), Stage: perftrace.StageRequested, Generation: state.generation,
121		})
122		return state.generation
123	}
124	
125	func (m *Model) beginLocalLoads(cause loadCause) (tasks, repos, tries uint64) {
126		if m.localCancel != nil {
127			m.localCancel()
128		}
129		m.localContext, m.localCancel = context.WithCancel(m.baseContext())
130		m.localGeneration++
131		tasks = m.beginViewLoad(ViewTasks, cause)
132		repos = m.beginViewLoad(ViewRepos, cause)
133		tries = m.beginViewLoad(ViewTries, cause)
134		if m.remoteClone.phase == remoteCloneRefreshing {
135			// Production's shared loader reads localContext rather than the per-view
136			// context created above, so cancellation follows the actual producer.
137			m.remoteClone.cancel = m.localCancel
138		}
139		return tasks, repos, tries
```

```text
   168	func matchesSize(usage *diskusage.Usage, expression string) bool {
   169		if usage == nil {
   170			return false
   171		}
   172		expression = strings.TrimSpace(expression)
   173		operator := "="
   174		for _, candidate := range []string{">=", "<=", ">", "<", "="} {
   175			if strings.HasPrefix(expression, candidate) {
   176				operator = candidate
   177				expression = strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(expression, candidate))
   178				break
   179			}
   180		}
   181		bytes, err := humanize.ParseBytes(expression)
   182		if err != nil {
   183			return false
   184		}
   185		owned := uint64(max(usage.OwnedBytes, 0))
   186		switch operator {
   187		case ">=":
   188			return owned >= bytes
   189		case "<=":
   190			return owned <= bytes
   191		case ">":
   192			return owned > bytes
   193		case "<":
   194			return owned < bytes
   195		default:
   196			return owned == bytes
   197		}
   198	}
```

```text
type selectionToken struct {
	revision string
	view     View

func repoItemKey(item repoItem) string {
	key := repoKey(item.Repo) + "\x00"
	if checkout, child := item.checkout(); child {
		return key + checkout.Worktree.Path
	}
	return key
}

func fleetRowKey(row FleetRow) string {
	if row.HostKey != "" {
		key := row.HostKey + "\x00" + row.EndpointID
		if row.Repository != nil {
			key += "\x00" + row.Repository.Path
		}
		return key
	}
	path := ""
	if row.Repository != nil {
		path = row.Repository.Path
	}
	return row.Host + "\x00" + path
}

func skillRowKey(row agentskill.Skill) string {
	lockFile := ""
	if row.Lock != nil {
		lockFile = row.Lock.File
	}
	return strings.Join([]string{string(row.Scope), row.Checkout, row.Path, lockFile, row.Name}, "\x00")
}

func (m Model) currentSelectionToken() (selectionToken, bool) {
	if row, ok := m.currentSSHEntry(); ok {
		token := selectionToken{view: ViewSSH, key: row.key()}
		if row.profile != nil {
			token.revision = row.profile.Fingerprint
		}
		return token, true
	}
	switch m.view {
	case ViewTasks:
		row, ok := m.currentTask()
		if !ok || row.Task == nil {
			return selectionToken{}, false

		return selectionToken{view: m.view, key: row.Task.ID, revision: row.Task.Revision()}, true
	case ViewRepos:
		row, ok := m.currentRepoItem()
		if !ok {
			return selectionToken{}, false
		}
		return selectionToken{view: m.view, key: repoItemKey(row)}, true
	case ViewFleet:
		row, ok := m.currentFleet()

			return selectionToken{}, false

		return selectionToken{view: m.view, key: fleetRowKey(row)}, true
	case ViewTries:

func (m Model) decorateTable(raw string) string {
	h := m.headerFrom(raw)
	order := m.activeTableSort()
	if order.column == "" || len(h.columns) == 0 {
		return raw
	}
	line := h.text
	for _, c := range h.columns {
		if c.key == order.column {
			arrow := "↑"
			if order.descending {
				arrow = "↓"
			}
			label := fitCell(strings.ToUpper(c.key)+" "+arrow, c.to-c.from)
			line = line[:c.from] + label + line[c.to:]
			break
		}
	}
	lines := strings.Split(raw, "\n")
	lines[h.line] = styleHeader.Render(line)
	return strings.Join(lines, "\n")
}
func (m Model) currentToken() selectionToken { t, _ := m.currentSelectionToken(); return t }
func (m Model) cycleTableSort(column string) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
	m.stopStartupFocus()
	focus, ok := m.currentSelectionToken()
	s := m.activeTableSort()
	switch {
	case s.column != column:
		s = tableSort{column: column}
	case !s.descending:
		s.descending = true
	default:
		s = tableSort{}
	}
	if m.snippetsActive() {
		m.snippets.order = s
	} else {
		m.tableSorts[int(m.view)] = s
	}
	m.statusSeverity = "info"
	m.status = "Default ordering"
	if s.column != "" {
		direction := "ascending"
		if s.descending {
			direction = "descending"
		}
		m.status = fmt.Sprintf("Sort %s: %s", strings.ToUpper(column), direction)
	}
	if ok {
		m.selectToken(focus)
	}
	return m, nil
}

type sortCell struct {
	known bool
	text  string
	nums  []int64
}

func textCell(s string) sortCell {
	return sortCell{known: s != "" && s != "—", text: strings.ToLower(s)}
}
func numberCell(n ...int64) sortCell { return sortCell{known: true, nums: n} }
func timeCell(t time.Time) sortCell {
	if t.IsZero() {
		return sortCell{}
	}
	return numberCell(t.UnixNano())
}
func gitSortCell(s gitx.Status) sortCell {
	return numberCell(int64(s.Conflicted), int64(s.Changed), int64(s.Ahead+s.Behind), int64(s.Ahead), int64(s.Behind))
}
func boolNumber(b bool) int64 {
	if b {
		return 1
	}
	return 0
}
func applyColumnSort[T any](m Model, rows []T, project func(T, string) sortCell) []T {
	s := m.activeTableSort()
	if s.column == "" {
		return rows
	}
	slices.SortStableFunc(rows, func(a, b T) int {
		x, y := project(a, s.column), project(b, s.column)
		if x.known != y.known {
			if x.known {
				return -1
			}
			return 1
		}
		if !x.known {
			return 0
		}
		c := 0
		if x.nums != nil || y.nums != nil {
			c = slices.Compare(x.nums, y.nums)
		} else {
			c = cmp.Compare(x.text, y.text)
		}
		if s.descending {
			return -c
		}
		return c
	})
	return rows
}
```

```text
package tui

import (
	"context"
	"os/exec"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/catalog"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/diskusage"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/fleet"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/forge"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/gitx"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/inventory"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/note"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/repo"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/runtime"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/stats"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/task"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/textmatch"
)

// RepoRow is one repository as the dashboard shows it: what it is, plus how
// much of it is currently in flight.
//
// The repository view exists because the task list alone answers only half the
// question. On a machine with forty repositories and no tasks recorded yet,
// a task-only dashboard is empty — and the honest answer to "what do I have
// here?" has to come before "what am I working on?"
// RepoActions groups catalog metadata mutations for ordinary repositories.
type RepoActions struct {
	Create      func() (*exec.Cmd, error)
	Patch       func(ctx context.Context, row RepoRow, tags []string, note string) (string, error)
	SetFavorite func(ctx context.Context, row RepoRow, desired bool) (*catalog.Entry, error)
}

type RepoRow struct {
	TopologyPending bool
	Pending         string
	Unavailable     string
	GitKnown        bool
	ObservedAt      time.Time
	Repo            repo.Repo
	Status          gitx.Status
	Topology        gitx.RecoveryTopology
	TopologyErr     error
	SizeTarget      diskusage.Target
	Usage           *diskusage.Usage
	SizeError       error
	// Asset is catalog metadata joined without persisting an otherwise
	// unobserved repository. A Try asset lets callers suppress or label it.
	Asset *catalog.Entry
	// Context is the canonical checkout plus every linked worktree, enriched
	// with task and runtime state. It is shared by the tree, copy actions and
	// `dev repo context`, so those surfaces cannot disagree.
	Context inventory.RepoContext
	// LastActivity is the newest commit time in this checkout. It is a durable,
	// cheap approximation of "when was this repo last touched" and is sortable.
	LastActivity time.Time
	// Worktrees is the number of linked worktrees, excluding the main checkout.
	Worktrees int
	// Tasks are the recorded tasks belonging to this repository.
	Tasks []*task.Task
	// NoteCount/LatestNote are joined from the durable sidecar store when this
	// repo already has a catalog identity.
	NoteCount  int
	LatestNote *note.Note
	// Live reports a runtime session sitting in this repository.
	Live          bool
	Runtime       string
	RuntimeHandle string
	RuntimeStatus string
	// RemoteForge / RemoteName identify origin for matching the REMOTE view to
	// this local checkout without rescanning every repo when a cache opens.
	RemoteForge forge.Kind
	RemoteName  string
}

// Favorite is durable catalog intent, independent of observation freshness.
func (r RepoRow) Favorite() bool { return r.Asset != nil && r.Asset.Favorite }

// Sessions returns every runtime session attached to any checkout in this
// repository.
func (r RepoRow) Sessions() []runtime.Session { return r.Context.Sessions() }

// HotTasks counts the repository's tasks that are currently hot.
// IsTry reports an ungraduated Try that should live in the dedicated TRY view,
// while remaining in the model's local snapshot for REMOTE matching.
func (r RepoRow) IsTry() bool {
	return r.Asset != nil && r.Asset.Kind == catalog.KindTry && r.Asset.Experiment != nil &&
		(r.Asset.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseActive || r.Asset.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseDeprecated)
}

func (r RepoRow) HotTasks() int {
	n := 0
	for _, t := range r.Tasks {
		if t.State == task.Hot {
			n++
		}
	}
	return n
}

// StateSummary renders the repository's tasks as a compact per-state tally,
// which is what makes the list scannable at forty repositories.
func (r RepoRow) StateSummary() string {
	if len(r.Tasks) == 0 {
		return ""
	}
	counts := map[task.State]int{}
	for _, t := range r.Tasks {
		counts[t.State]++
	}
	var parts []string
	for _, s := range task.States {
		if counts[s] > 0 {
			parts = append(parts, s.Icon()+strconv.Itoa(counts[s]))
		}
	}
	return strings.Join(parts, " ")
}

// searchText is what a filter query matches against.
func (r RepoRow) searchText() string {
		return textCell(r.Repo.Display())
	case "branch":
		return textCell(r.Status.Branch)
	case "git":
		if r.Context.IdentityErr != nil || r.Context.WorktreeErr != nil {
			return sortCell{}
		}
		return gitSortCell(r.Status)
	case "size":
		if r.Usage != nil && r.Usage.Complete {
			return numberCell(r.Usage.OwnedBytes)
		}
	case "live":
		if r.Context.RuntimeErr != nil {
			return sortCell{}
		}
		return textCell(parentLiveColumn(r))
	case "latest":
		return timeCell(r.LastActivity)
	case "wt":
		if r.Context.WorktreeErr == nil {
			return numberCell(int64(r.Worktrees))
		}
	case "tasks":
		return numberCell(int64(len(r.Tasks)))
	case "notes":
		return numberCell(int64(r.NoteCount))
	case "category":
		return textCell(r.Repo.Category)
	case "path":
		return textCell(r.Repo.Path)
	case "remote":
		if r.TopologyErr == nil {
			return textCell(r.Topology.Summary())
		}
	}
	return sortCell{}
}
func tryCell(r TryRow, key string) sortCell {
	switch key {
	case "try":
		return textCell(r.Item.DisplayName())
	case "phase":
		return textCell(string(r.Item.Phase))
	case "where":
		return textCell(r.Where())
	case "git":
		if r.Item.Live.Status != nil && r.Item.Live.StatusError == nil {
			return gitSortCell(*r.Item.Live.Status)
		}
	case "last":
		return timeCell(r.Item.Activity())
	case "size":
		if r.Usage != nil && r.Usage.Complete {
			return numberCell(r.Usage.OwnedBytes)
		}
	case "tags":
		return textCell(strings.Join(r.Item.Tags, ","))
	}
	return sortCell{}
}
```

```text
package diskusage

import (
	"context"
	"sync"
	"sync/atomic"
)

// ScanFunc is the measurement seam used by Manager tests.
type ScanFunc func(context.Context, Target) (Usage, error)

// Result is one streamed row measurement.
type Result struct {
	LoadID uint64
	Key    string
	Usage  Usage
	Err    error
}

// Load is a cancellable stream. Results closes after every unique target is
// delivered or the context is cancelled.
type Load struct {
	ID      uint64
	Results <-chan Result
}

// Manager bounds scans and shares one derived cache across CLI and TUI callers.
type Manager struct {
	Cache   *Cache
	Workers int
	Scan    ScanFunc

	next atomic.Uint64
	mu   sync.Mutex
	stop map[uint64]context.CancelFunc
}

// NewManager returns a manager with portable scanner defaults.
func NewManager(cache *Cache, workers int) *Manager {
	if workers <= 0 {
		workers = 2
	}
	return &Manager{Cache: cache, Workers: workers, Scan: Scan, stop: map[uint64]context.CancelFunc{}}
}

// Measure returns one cache hit or fresh scan.
func (m *Manager) Measure(ctx context.Context, target Target, force bool) (Usage, error) {
	if ctx == nil {
		ctx = context.Background()
	}
	if !force && m != nil && m.Cache != nil {
		if usage, ok, _ := m.Cache.Get(target); ok {
			return usage, nil
		}
	}
	scanner := ScanFunc(Scan)
	if m != nil && m.Scan != nil {
		scanner = m.Scan
	}
	usage, err := scanner(ctx, target)
	if err != nil {
		return Usage{}, err
	}
	if m != nil && m.Cache != nil {
		_ = m.Cache.Set(target, usage)
	}
	return usage, nil
}

// Start streams unique targets through a bounded worker pool.
func (m *Manager) Start(parent context.Context, targets []Target, force bool) Load {
	if parent == nil {
		parent = context.Background()
	}
	if m == nil {
		results := make(chan Result)
		close(results)
		return Load{Results: results}
	}
	id := m.next.Add(1)
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(parent)
	m.mu.Lock()
	if m.stop == nil {
		m.stop = map[uint64]context.CancelFunc{}
	}
	m.stop[id] = cancel
	m.mu.Unlock()

	unique := make([]Target, 0, len(targets))
	seen := map[string]struct{}{}
	for _, target := range targets {
		key := targetKey(target)
		if _, ok := seen[key]; ok {
			continue
		}
		seen[key] = struct{}{}
		target.Key = key
		unique = append(unique, target)
	}
	results := make(chan Result, len(unique))
	load := Load{ID: id, Results: results}
	go m.run(ctx, cancel, load, unique, force, results)
	return load
}

func (m *Manager) run(ctx context.Context, cancel context.CancelFunc, load Load, targets []Target, force bool, results chan<- Result) {
	defer close(results)
	defer cancel()
	defer func() {
		m.mu.Lock()
		delete(m.stop, load.ID)
		m.mu.Unlock()
	}()

	jobs := make(chan Target)
	workers := m.Workers
	if workers <= 0 {
		workers = 2
	}
	if workers > len(targets) {
		workers = len(targets)
	}
	if workers == 0 {
		return
	}
	var wait sync.WaitGroup
	wait.Add(workers)
	for range workers {
		go func() {
			defer wait.Done()
			for {
				var target Target
				var ok bool
				select {
				case <-ctx.Done():
					return
				case target, ok = <-jobs:
					if !ok {
						return
					}
```

```text
// Cancel stops one active load. It is safe after completion.
func (m *Manager) Cancel(id uint64) {
	if m == nil || id == 0 {
		return
	}
	m.mu.Lock()
	cancel := m.stop[id]
	m.mu.Unlock()
	if cancel != nil {
		cancel()
	}
}

// Invalidate drops cached ownership layouts changed by a local mutation.
func (m *Manager) Invalidate(targets ...Target) error {
	if m == nil || m.Cache == nil {
		return nil
	}
	return m.Cache.Invalidate(targets...)
}
```

```text
package cli

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"time"

	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/diskusage"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/forge"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/gitx"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/inventory"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/note"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/runtime"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/task"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/tui"
)

// prepareRepoRowCollector reads shared inputs once. Admission and the shared
// limiter belong to callers, not to one goroutine per repository.
func prepareRepoRowCollector(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, options repoCollectOptions) (func(context.Context, tui.RepoRow) tui.RepoRow, error) {
	tasks := options.Tasks
	var taskInventoryErr error
	if !options.TasksSet {
		var diagnostics []task.Diagnostic
		var err error
		tasks, diagnostics, err = app.Tasks.ListWithDiagnostics()
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
			taskInventoryErr = errors.Join(taskInventoryErr, diagnostic)
		}
	}
	byRepo := map[string][]*task.Task{}
	for _, tracked := range tasks {
		byRepo[tracked.RepoPath] = append(byRepo[tracked.RepoPath], tracked)
	}
	sessions, runtimeErr := options.Sessions, options.SessionsErr
	if !options.SessionsSet {
		sessions, runtimeErr = rt.List(ctx)
	}
	notesByRepo := map[string][]*note.Note{}
	if app.Notes != nil {
		allNotes, err := app.Notes.List("")
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		for _, n := range allNotes {
			notesByRepo[n.RepositoryID] = append(notesByRepo[n.RepositoryID], n)
		}
	}
	return func(ctx context.Context, row tui.RepoRow) tui.RepoRow {
		r := row.Repo
		row.ObservedAt = time.Now()
		if row.Asset != nil {
			repoNotes := notesByRepo[row.Asset.ID]
			row.NoteCount = len(repoNotes)
			if len(repoNotes) > 0 {
				row.LatestNote = repoNotes[0]
			}
		}
		if r.HasGit {
			if options.DeferTopology {
				row.TopologyPending = true
				row.TopologyErr = errors.New("recovery details not loaded")
			} else {
				row.Topology, row.TopologyErr = gitx.RecoveryTopologyOf(ctx, r.Path)
			}
		}
		row.Tasks = append(row.Tasks, byRepo[r.Path]...)
		if r.RealPath != "" && r.RealPath != r.Path {
			row.Tasks = append(row.Tasks, byRepo[r.RealPath]...)
		}
		row.Context = inventory.CollectRepoContext(ctx, r, row.Tasks, sessions, rt.Name())
		row.Context.TaskErr = taskInventoryErr
		row.Context.RuntimeErr = runtimeErr
		row.LastActivity, row.Worktrees = row.Context.LastActivity, row.Context.WorktreeCount
		if main, ok := row.Context.Main(); ok {
			row.Status = main.Status
			row.GitKnown = main.StatusErr == nil && main.Exists && main.PathErr == nil && !main.Worktree.Prunable
		}
		if !r.Bare {
			row.RemoteForge, row.RemoteName = forge.IdentityFromURL(gitx.RemoteFromConfig(r.CommonDir, "origin"))
		}
		if live := row.Context.Sessions(); len(live) > 0 {
			row.Live, row.Runtime = true, rt.Name()
			row.RuntimeHandle, row.RuntimeStatus = live[0].Handle, live[0].AgentStatus
		}
		if r.HasGit {
			row.SizeTarget = diskusage.FromGit(gitx.Repo{
				Root: r.Path, GitDir: r.GitDir, GitCommonDir: r.CommonDir,
				MainRoot: r.MainRoot, Name: r.Name, Bare: r.Bare,
			}, row.Worktrees)
		} else {
			row.SizeTarget = diskusage.Plain(r.Path)
		}
		return row
	}, nil
}
```

```text
type RemotePRs struct {
	LargeRepoThreshold int      `toml:"large_repo_threshold"`
	PageSize           int      `toml:"page_size"`
	CacheTTL           Duration `toml:"cache_ttl"`
}

func (c Config) EffectiveRemotePRs() RemotePRs {
	p := c.TUI.Remote.PRs
	if p.LargeRepoThreshold == 0 {
		p.LargeRepoThreshold = 50
	}
	if p.PageSize == 0 {
		p.PageSize = 50
	}
	if p.CacheTTL.Duration == 0 {
		p.CacheTTL.Duration = 5 * time.Minute
	}
	return p
}

// FleetTable configures the dashboard's host tree. It does not change the
// explicit network behavior of non-interactive fleet commands.
type FleetTable struct {
	BackgroundRefresh bool `toml:"background_refresh"`

// RepoTable configures columns and ordering in the TUI REPOS view.
type RepoTable struct {
	// Columns may contain repo, branch, git, remote, size, live, latest,
	// worktrees, tasks, notes, category, or path, in the exact display order wanted.
	Columns []string `toml:"columns"`
	// Sort is activity, latest, name, git, or tasks.
	Sort string `toml:"sort"`
	// Reverse flips the selected order.
	Reverse bool `toml:"reverse"`
}

// DefaultRepoColumns is the useful full local inventory without paths (detail
// shows the selected path).
func DefaultRepoColumns() []string {
	return []string{"repo", "branch", "git", "size", "live", "latest", "worktrees", "tasks"}
}

// EffectiveRepoColumns returns configured columns or the defaults.
func (c Config) EffectiveRepoColumns() []string {
	if len(c.TUI.Repos.Columns) == 0 {
		return DefaultRepoColumns()
	}
	return c.TUI.Repos.Columns
}

// EffectiveRepoSort returns the configured ordering or activity-first.
func (c Config) EffectiveRepoSort() string {
	if c.TUI.Repos.Sort == "" {
		return "activity"
	}
	return c.TUI.Repos.Sort
}
```

```text
package repo

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"time"

	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/gitx"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/safefile"
)

// CachedRow holds presentation only: no task, runtime or action authority.
type CachedRow struct {
	Repo         Repo
	Status       gitx.Status
	GitKnown     bool
	LastActivity time.Time
	Try          bool
}
type Snapshot struct {
	Version     int
	Fingerprint [32]byte
	ObservedAt  time.Time
	Rows        []CachedRow
}

func SnapshotKey(roots []string, state string) [32]byte {
	data, _ := json.Marshal(struct {
		Roots []string
		State string
	}{roots, state})
	return sha256.Sum256(data)
}
func ReadSnapshot(ctx context.Context, path string, key [32]byte) (Snapshot, error) {
	data, err := safefile.ReadRegular(ctx, path, 8<<20)
	if err != nil {
		return Snapshot{}, err
	}
	var snapshot Snapshot
	if err = json.Unmarshal(data, &snapshot); err != nil {
		return Snapshot{}, err
	}
	if snapshot.Version != 1 || snapshot.Fingerprint != key || snapshot.ObservedAt.IsZero() {
		return Snapshot{}, errors.New("repository cache does not match this discovery configuration")
	}
	for _, r := range snapshot.Rows {
		if !filepath.IsAbs(r.Repo.Path) || r.Repo.Name == "" {
			return Snapshot{}, errors.New("invalid cached repository")
		}
	}
	return snapshot, nil
}
func WriteSnapshot(path string, snapshot Snapshot) error {
	snapshot.Version = 1
	data, err := json.Marshal(snapshot)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if len(data) > 8<<20 {
		return errors.New("repository cache exceeds 8 MiB")
	}
	if err = os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0700); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	file, err := os.CreateTemp(filepath.Dir(path), ".repos-*")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer os.Remove(file.Name())
	if _, err = file.Write(data); err != nil {
		file.Close()
		return err
	}
	if err = file.Close(); err != nil {
		return err
	}

func TestRepoProgressRejectsLateCacheAndKeepsFocus(t *testing.T) {
	m := New(Actions{}, nil, nil)
	m.view = ViewRepos
	m.width = 100
	m.height = 30
	generation := m.beginViewLoad(ViewRepos, loadInitial)
	a := RepoRow{Repo: repo.Repo{Name: "a", Path: "/a"}, Pending: "cached"}
	b := RepoRow{Repo: repo.Repo{Name: "b", Path: "/b"}, Pending: "loading"}
	m, _ = m.applyLocalResult(LocalResult{View: ViewRepos, Generation: generation, Phase: "cache", Repos: []RepoRow{a}, Valid: true})
	token := m.currentToken()
	m, _ = m.applyLocalResult(LocalResult{View: ViewRepos, Generation: generation, Phase: "discovery", Repos: []RepoRow{b}, Valid: true})
	if token != m.currentToken() {
		t.Fatal("partial result moved focus")
	}
	var accepted bool
	m, accepted = m.applyLocalResult(LocalResult{View: ViewRepos, Generation: generation, Phase: "cache", Repos: []RepoRow{{}}, Valid: true})
	if accepted {
		t.Fatal("late cache accepted")
	}
	a.Pending = ""
	m, _ = m.applyLocalResult(LocalResult{View: ViewRepos, Generation: generation, Repos: []RepoRow{a}, Valid: true})
	if len(m.repos) != 1 || m.repos[0].Pending != "" {
		t.Fatal(m.repos)
	}
	m, accepted = m.applyLocalResult(LocalResult{View: ViewRepos, Generation: generation, Phase: "enrichment", Repos: []RepoRow{b}, Valid: true})
	if accepted {
		t.Fatal("post-completion patch accepted")
	}
}
```

```text
// is another one — is never in doubt.
func (m Model) renderHeader() string { return m.buildHeaderLayout().line + "\n" }

// window returns the slice of a list visible around the cursor, and the offset
// it starts at, so a long inventory scrolls instead of overflowing.
func (m Model) window(n int) (from, to int) {
	h := m.listHeight()
	if n <= h {
		return 0, n
	}
	from = m.at() - h/2
	if from < 0 {
		from = 0
	}
	if from+h > n {
		from = n - h
	}
	return from, from + h
}

func (m Model) renderRepos() string {
	items := m.visibleRepoItems()
	if len(items) == 0 {
		if m.startupOutside() {
			return "  " + fitCell("No configured repositories yet.", max(1, m.width-2)) + "\n"
		}
		if m.viewLoad(ViewRepos).loading {
			return "  " + styleDim.Render("Loading local repositories…") + "\n"
		}
		return "  " + styleDim.Render("No repositories found. Check paths.scan_roots in your config,"+
			" or run `dev config init`.\n")
	}
	columns := m.repoColumns()

	var b strings.Builder
	var headers []string
	for _, c := range columns {
		headers = append(headers, fitCell(c.header, c.width))
	}
	b.WriteString(styleHeader.Render("  "+strings.Join(headers, "  ")) + "\n")
```

```text
func (m Model) readStartupRepo() tea.Cmd {
	if m.actions.Discovery.Read == nil {
		return nil
	}
	return func() tea.Msg {
		r, err := m.actions.Discovery.Read(m.baseContext())
		return startupRepoMsg{generation: m.configGeneration, repository: r, err: err}
	}
}

func (m *Model) stopStartupFocus() {
	if m.view == ViewRepos {
		m.startupRepo.focusDone = true
		m.startupRepo.refocusAfterSave = false
	}
}

func (m *Model) focusStartupRepo() {
	s := &m.startupRepo
	if m.view != ViewRepos || s.focusDone || !s.loaded || m.mode != modeList || m.overlay.kind != overlayNone {
		return
	}
	if s.err != nil || s.repository.CommonDir == "" {
		s.focusDone = true
		return
	}
	for i, item := range m.visibleRepoItems() {
		if !item.child() && item.Repo.Repo.CommonDir == s.repository.CommonDir {
			m.repoCursor = i
			s.focusDone = true
			return
		}
	}
	if state := m.viewLoad(ViewRepos); state.hasSnapshot && !state.loading {
		s.focusDone = true
	}
}

func (m Model) startupOutside() bool {
	s := m.startupRepo
	state := m.viewLoad(ViewRepos)
	if !s.loaded || s.err != nil || s.repository.Path == "" || s.repository.CommonDir == "" ||
		s.repository.Covered || s.repository.CoverageErr != nil || s.saved ||
		!state.hasSnapshot || state.loading || m.viewError(ViewRepos) != nil {
		return false
	}
	// TRY rows share local inventory but must not be re-enrolled as REPOS.
	for _, row := range m.repos {
		if row.Repo.CommonDir == s.repository.CommonDir {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

type discoveryButton struct {
	line, from, to int
	action         listAction
}
type discoveryBanner struct {
	text    string
	lines   int
	buttons []discoveryButton
}

func (m Model) discoveryBanner() discoveryBanner {
func (m *Model) afterReposResult(valid bool, err error) tea.Cmd {
	fresh := valid && err == nil
	var commands []tea.Cmd
	for _, view := range []View{ViewFleet, ViewSkills, ViewMCP} {
		if !m.viewUsesRepos(view) {
			continue
		}
		state := m.viewLoad(view)
		if state.loading || m.view == view {
			m.beginViewLoad(view, loadRefresh)
			if fresh {
				m.setViewStatus(view, dependentLoadingStatus(view))
				commands = append(commands, m.reloadDependentView(view))
				continue
			}
			dependencyErr := err
			if dependencyErr == nil {
				dependencyErr = errors.New("local repository inventory is unavailable")
			}
			current := m.viewLoad(view)
			m.applyViewResult(view, current.generation, false, "", "", 0, dependencyErr, false)
			continue
		}
		if state.hasSnapshot {
			m.invalidateView(view)
		}
	}
	return batchCommands(commands...)
}

// afterViewSwitch lazily loads optional inventories only when their view is
// first opened, so starting the dashboard never waits on the network, a forge
// CLI, or Node tooling.
```

```text
522
```

```text
// A successful intent write survives older cache/enrichment messages and scan
// generations. A newer catalog revision remains authoritative for all metadata.
func (m Model) withRepoFavorite(row RepoRow) RepoRow {
	for id, saved := range m.repoFavorites {
		if row.Asset != nil && row.Asset.ID != "" {
			if row.Asset.ID != id {
				continue
			}
			if row.Asset.Updated.After(saved.asset.Updated) {
				return row
			}
			row.Asset = row.Asset.Clone()
			row.Asset.Favorite = saved.asset.Favorite
			return row
		}
		if !sameFavoriteRepository(row.Repo, saved.repository) {
			continue
		}
		row.Asset = saved.asset.Clone()
		return row
	}
	return row
}

func sameFavoriteRepository(a, b repo.Repo) bool {
	if a.CommonDir != "" && b.CommonDir != "" {
		return a.CommonDir == b.CommonDir
	}
	if a.RealPath != "" && b.RealPath != "" {
		return a.RealPath == b.RealPath
	}
	return a.Path != "" && a.Path == b.Path
}
```

```text
func TestRepoProgressRejectsLateCacheAndKeepsFocus(t *testing.T) {
	m := New(Actions{}, nil, nil)
	m.view = ViewRepos
	m.width = 100
	m.height = 30
	generation := m.beginViewLoad(ViewRepos, loadInitial)
	a := RepoRow{Repo: repo.Repo{Name: "a", Path: "/a"}, Pending: "cached"}
	b := RepoRow{Repo: repo.Repo{Name: "b", Path: "/b"}, Pending: "loading"}
	m, _ = m.applyLocalResult(LocalResult{View: ViewRepos, Generation: generation, Phase: "cache", Repos: []RepoRow{a}, Valid: true})
	token := m.currentToken()
	m, _ = m.applyLocalResult(LocalResult{View: ViewRepos, Generation: generation, Phase: "discovery", Repos: []RepoRow{b}, Valid: true})
	if token != m.currentToken() {
		t.Fatal("partial result moved focus")
	}
	var accepted bool
	m, accepted = m.applyLocalResult(LocalResult{View: ViewRepos, Generation: generation, Phase: "cache", Repos: []RepoRow{{}}, Valid: true})
	if accepted {
		t.Fatal("late cache accepted")
	}
	a.Pending = ""
	m, _ = m.applyLocalResult(LocalResult{View: ViewRepos, Generation: generation, Repos: []RepoRow{a}, Valid: true})
	if len(m.repos) != 1 || m.repos[0].Pending != "" {
		t.Fatal(m.repos)
	}
	m, accepted = m.applyLocalResult(LocalResult{View: ViewRepos, Generation: generation, Phase: "enrichment", Repos: []RepoRow{b}, Valid: true})
	if accepted {
		t.Fatal("post-completion patch accepted")
	}
}
```
