func TestStreamingReposPublishGitBeforeRuntimeAndCacheCompletedRows(t *testing.T) {
	app, _ := newRepoWizardApp(t, "")
	git := gittest.New(t)
	app.Cfg.Paths.ScanRoots = []string{git.Root}
	app.Cfg.Paths.RepoPaths = nil
	app.trace = perftrace.New(512)
	loader := newTUILocalLoader(app, nil)
	gate := make(chan struct{})
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	defer cancel()
	loader.loadRuntime = func(ctx context.Context) (tuiRuntimeSnapshot, error) {
		select {
		case <-gate:
			return tuiRuntimeSnapshot{runtime: runtime.None{}}, nil
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return tuiRuntimeSnapshot{}, ctx.Err()
		}
	}
	loader.collectTasks = func(context.Context, []*task.Task, tuiRuntimeSnapshot, *inventory.Limiter) ([]inventory.Row, error) {
		return nil, nil
	}
	loader.collectTries = func(context.Context, bool, tuiRuntimeSnapshot) ([]tui.TryRow, error) { return nil, nil }
	load := loader.Start(ctx, tui.LocalLoadRequest{ReposGeneration: 1})
	timer := time.After(10 * time.Second)
	sawGit := false
	for !sawGit {
		select {
		case result := <-load.Results:
			if result.Phase == "enrichment" {
				if len(result.Repos) != 1 || !result.Repos[0].GitKnown || result.Repos[0].Context.RuntimeErr == nil {
					t.Fatalf("%+v", result)
				}
				sawGit = true
			}
		case <-timer:
			t.Fatal("runtime blocked Git rows")
		}
	}
	close(gate)
	complete := false
	for result := range load.Results {
		if result.View == tui.ViewRepos && result.Phase == "" {
			complete = result.Valid && result.Err == nil && result.Repos[0].Pending == ""
		}
	}
	if !complete {
		t.Fatal("no completed repository result")
	}
	cache, err := repo.ReadSnapshot(ctx, filepath.Join(cacheRoot(), "repos-v1.json"), repo.SnapshotKey(app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), app.Cfg.StateDir()))
	if err != nil || len(cache.Rows) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("cache %+v: %v", cache, err)
	}
}

PROBLEM (user report with screenshot): opening the dashboard's REPOS tab (106 repos) feels janky: rows keep reordering while background data (Git status, Herdr runtime status, latest commit, size) streams in, and the SIZE column flips "—" → "…" → value.

MECHANISM I already traced (verify, don't re-derive from scratch):
- Loader: internal/cli/tui_load.go `Start` (lines ~80-313). Order: "favorites" seeds → "cache" phase (repo.ReadSnapshot of $XDG_CACHE/dev/repos-v1.json, rows carry Repo, Status, LastActivity, GitKnown, Pending="cached"; NO Tasks/Live/Worktrees/SizeTarget) → "discovery" per-candidate rows (Pending="loading") → collectTUIRepoStream (internal/cli/tui_repo_load.go) publishes one "enrichment" LocalResult PER REPO (tasks, status, LastActivity, Worktrees, SizeTarget via prepareRepoRowCollector in tui_repo_collect.go) and, once the Herdr `rt.List` future resolves, one "runtime" LocalResult PER already-complete repo (joinRuntime sets Live/RuntimeStatus) → final complete LocalResult with Phase=="" → cache written (repo.WriteSnapshot, internal/repo/cache.go, Version 1, CachedRow{Repo,Status,GitKnown,LastActivity,Try}).

Every message re-renders; there is no coalescing. ~106×2 progress messages + final.
- Sorting: internal/tui/model.go `visibleRepos` (~line 1286) re-sorts on every render: compareRepos (line ~1613) default "activity" = HotTasks desc → Live desc → Status.Dirty desc → len(Tasks) desc → LastActivity desc → name; then applyColumnSort (table.go:143), then favorites-first stable partition. Because cached rows have no Tasks/Live, each enrichment/runtime message changes sort keys and rows jump. Config: [tui.repos] sort/reverse (config.go EffectiveRepoSort); `O`/`R` keys cycle sort/reverse in the view; column sort via activeTableSort.
- Focus: applyRepoProgress saves m.currentToken()/repoFocusPath() and restoreRepoFocus by path (good already).

1. Order freeze during streaming: while REPOS load is in flight (repoProgressPhase < 3 / state.loading), visibleRepos keeps a frozen order (a []string of repoKey captured when the cache/favorites phase is applied, sorted with current comparator using data available then; rows discovered later append at the end in arrival order). # CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

`AGENTS.md` is the canonical repository guidance file. `CLAUDE.md` is a symlink to it; edit this file rather than replacing the symlink.

## Toolchain and commands

- Go 1.26.4 (from `go.mod`) builds the CLI. Python 3.11+ and `uv` are used only for the documentation site.
- `make` / `make all` runs `fmt -> vet -> test -> build`. `make fmt` runs `gofmt -w .` and therefore modifies files.
- There is no working `make lint` recipe even though `lint` appears in `.PHONY`. The repository's static gates are formatting and `go vet`.

```bash
make build                         # build ./dev with git-derived version metadata
make test                          # go test ./...
go test -race -timeout 20m ./...   # CI test command
go test ./internal/gitx -run '^TestAddWorktreeUsesExplicitBase$'  # one test
go test ./internal/cli -run '^TestName/Subtest$'                  # one subtest
make vet                           # go vet ./...
files="$(gofmt -l .)" && test -z "$files"  # format check that preserves gofmt failures
make e2e                           # real CLI lifecycle in an isolated temporary HOME
make skill-sync                    # regenerate command docs, then rebuild embedded skill
make skill-check                   # fail when command tree and generated skill reference drift
make install                       # binary under PREFIX; skill in user agent directories
```

Documentation uses the same sequence as CI:

```bash
uv sync --frozen --extra docs
uv run python scripts/check-docs.py --source
uv run mkdocs build --strict
uv run python scripts/check-docs.py --site site
```

If generated `docs/llms*.txt` files drift, regenerate them with `uv run python scripts/check-docs.py --source --generate-llms` and then rerun the documentation checks.

## Architecture

The executable path is deliberately shallow:

```text
cmd/dev/main.go
  -> cli.Execute()
...
</persisted-output>

212			}
213			send(tui.LocalResult{
214				View: tui.ViewTasks, Generation: request.TasksGeneration,
215				Tasks: rows, Valid: !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) && (err == nil || rows != nil), Err: err,
216			})
217		})
218		producers.Go(func() {
219			var rows []tui.RepoRow
220			var err error
221			if streaming {
222				metadata, catalogErr := catalogState.wait(ctx)
223				if len(metadata.seeds) > 0 {
224					send(tui.LocalResult{View: tui.ViewRepos, Generation: request.ReposGeneration, Repos: metadata.seeds, Valid: true, Phase: "favorites"})
225				}
226				finish := appSnapshot.trace.Start(perftrace.TUICacheReposRead, perftrace.Fields{})
227				snapshot, cacheErr := repo.ReadSnapshot(ctx, cachePath, key)
228				finish(resolverOutcome(cacheErr))
229				if cacheErr == nil {
230					cached := make([]tui.RepoRow, 0, len(snapshot.Rows))
231					for _, r := range snapshot.Rows {
232						row := tui.RepoRow{Repo: r.Repo, Status: r.Status, LastActivity: r.LastActivity, ObservedAt: snapshot.ObservedAt, Pending: "cached", GitKnown: r.GitKnown, Asset: metadata.asset(r.Repo)}
233						if r.Try && row.Asset == nil {
234							row.Asset = &catalog.Entry{Kind: catalog.KindTry, Experiment: &catalog.Experiment{Phase: catalog.PhaseActive}}
235						}
236						cached = append(cached, row)
237					}
238					send(tui.LocalResult{View: tui.ViewRepos, Generation: request.ReposGeneration, Repos: cached, Valid: true, Phase: "cache"})
239				}
240				close(presentationReady)
241				tracked, tasksErr := tasks.wait(ctx)
242				err = errors.Join(catalogErr, tasksErr)
243				collectRow := l.collectRepoRow
244				var collectErr error
245				if collectRow == nil && ctx.Err() == nil {
246					collectRow, collectErr = prepareRepoRowCollector(ctx, &appSnapshot, runtime.None{}, repoCollectOptions{
247						IncludeTries: true, DeferTopology: true, Tasks: tracked, TasksSet: true,
248						SessionsSet: true, SessionsErr: errors.New("runtime observation pending"),
249					})
250				}
251				validate := l.discoverFavorite
252				if validate == nil {
253					validate = discoverTUIFavorite
254				}
255				finish = appSnapshot.trace.Start(perftrace.TUIProducerRepos, perftrace.Fields{View: perftrace.ViewRepos, Generation: request.ReposGeneration})
256				if collectRow != nil && ctx.Err() == nil {
257					rows, collectErr = collectTUIRepoStream(ctx, metadata, repositories, runtimeState, limiter, validate, collectRow, tasksErr,
258						func(phase string, row tui.RepoRow) {
259							send(tui.LocalResult{View: tui.ViewRepos, Generation: request.ReposGeneration, Repos: []tui.RepoRow{row}, Valid: true, Phase: phase})
260						})
261				} else if ctx.Err() == nil {
262					for _, row := range metadata.seeds {
263						row.Pending, row.Unavailable = "unavailable", collectErr.Error()
264						rows = append(rows, row)
265					}
266				}
267				err = errors.Join(err, collectErr, ctx.Err())
268				finish(resolverOutcome(err))
269			} else {
270				// Custom collectors keep the original shared-source contract.
271				tracked, tasksErr := tasks.wait(ctx)
272				discovered, reposErr := repositories.wait(ctx)
273				live, runtimeErr := runtimeState.wait(ctx)
274				err = errors.Join(tasksErr, reposErr, runtimeErr)
275				if ctx.Err() == nil && (err == nil || discovered != nil) {
276					var collectErr error
277					rows, collectErr = l.collectRepos(ctx, tracked, discovered, live, limiter)
278					err = errors.Join(err, collectErr)
279				}
280			}
281			if streaming && err == nil && ctx.Err() == nil {
282				snapshot := repo.Snapshot{Fingerprint: key, ObservedAt: time.Now()}
283				for _, r := range rows {
284					snapshot.Rows = append(snapshot.Rows, repo.CachedRow{Repo: r.Repo, Status: r.Status, GitKnown: r.GitKnown, LastActivity: r.LastActivity, Try: r.IsTry()})
285				}
286				_ = repo.WriteSnapshot(cachePath, snapshot)
287			}
288			send(tui.LocalResult{View: tui.ViewRepos, Generation: request.ReposGeneration, Repos: rows, Valid: !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) && (err == nil || rows != nil), Err: err})
289		})
290		producers.Go(func() {
291			runtimeSnapshot, err := runtimeState.wait(ctx)
292			var rows []tui.TryRow
293			if err == nil {
294				finish := l.app.trace.Start(perftrace.TUIProducerTries, perftrace.Fields{
295					View: perftrace.ViewTries, Generation: request.TriesGeneration,
296				})
297				rows, err = collectTries(ctx, request.ShowAllTries, runtimeSnapshot)
298				finish(resolverOutcome(err))
299			}
300			send(tui.LocalResult{
301				View: tui.ViewTries, Generation: request.TriesGeneration,
302				Tries: rows, Valid: !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) && (err == nil || rows != nil), Err: err,
303			})
304		})
305		go func() {
306			producers.Wait()
307			// Discovery's candidate callback is also a producer. On cancellation,
308			// wait for it to leave before closing the result stream.
309			<-repositories.ready
310			close(results)
311		}()
312		return tui.LocalLoad{ID: id, Request: request, Results: results}
313	}
314	
315	func joinRuntime(row *tui.RepoRow, live tuiRuntimeSnapshot) {
316		name := "none"
317		if live.runtime != nil {
318			name = live.runtime.Name()
319		}
320		row.Context = inventory.WithRuntime(row.Context, name, live.sessions, live.err)
321		row.Live = false
322		row.RuntimeHandle = ""
323		row.RuntimeStatus = ""
324		row.Runtime = name
325		if sessions := row.Context.Sessions(); len(sessions) > 0 {
326			row.Live = true
327			row.RuntimeHandle = sessions[0].Handle
328			row.RuntimeStatus = sessions[0].AgentStatus
329		}
330	}

14	type tuiRepoJob struct {
15		index    int
16		validate bool
17		row      tui.RepoRow
18	}
19	
20	type tuiRepoDone struct {
21		job     tuiRepoJob
22		row     tui.RepoRow
23		err     error
24		proceed chan bool
25	}
26	
27	type tuiRepoRecord struct {
28		row      tui.RepoRow
29		complete bool
30	}
31	
32	// collectTUIRepoStream owns admission, deduplication and publication. Only one
33	// cancellable permit request is outstanding; there is never a goroutine per
34	// queued repository. A slow favorite occupies its own slot, not a phase barrier.
35	func collectTUIRepoStream(ctx context.Context, metadata tuiRepoCatalog, repositories *tuiFuture[[]repo.Repo], live *tuiFuture[tuiRuntimeSnapshot], limiter *inventory.Limiter,
36		validate func(context.Context, repo.Repo) (repo.Repo, error), collect func(context.Context, tui.RepoRow) tui.RepoRow,
37		tasksErr error, publish func(string, tui.RepoRow)) ([]tui.RepoRow, error) {
38		var records []tuiRepoRecord
39		var favorites, ordinary []tuiRepoJob
40		reserved := map[string]int{}
41		known := map[string]bool{}
42		owners := map[string]int{}
43		for _, row := range metadata.seeds {
44			index := len(records)
45			records = append(records, tuiRepoRecord{row: row})
46			favorites = append(favorites, tuiRepoJob{index: index, validate: true, row: row})
47			for _, key := range tuiRepoKeys(row.Repo) {
48				reserved[key]++
49			}
50		}
51		var pending []repo.Repo
52		admitDiscovered := func() {
53			waiting := pending[:0]
54			for _, r := range pending {
55				keys := tuiRepoKeys(r)
56				duplicate, held := false, false
57				for _, key := range keys {
58					duplicate = duplicate || known[key]
59					held = held || reserved[key] > 0
60				}
61				if duplicate {
62					for _, key := range keys {
63						if known[key] {
64							owner := owners[key]
65							if preferTUIRepoAlias(&records[owner].row, r) && records[owner].complete {
66								publish("enrichment", records[owner].row)
67							}
68							break
69						}
70					}
71					continue
72				}
73				if held {
74					waiting = append(waiting, r)
75					continue
76				}
77				row := tui.RepoRow{Repo: r, Asset: metadata.asset(r)}
78				job := tuiRepoJob{index: len(records), row: row}
79				records = append(records, tuiRepoRecord{row: row})
80				for _, key := range keys {
81					known[key], owners[key] = true, job.index
82				}
83				if row.Favorite() {
84					favorites = append(favorites, job)
85				} else {
86					ordinary = append(ordinary, job)
87				}
88			}
89			pending = waiting
90		}
91	
92		completed := make(chan tuiRepoDone, 8)
93		permits := make(chan func())
94		var workers sync.WaitGroup
95		workerCtx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
96		defer func() { cancel(); workers.Wait() }()
97		var err error
98		active, acquiring := 0, false
99		discoveryReady, runtimeReady := repositories.ready, live.ready
100		var runtimeSnapshot tuiRuntimeSnapshot
101		var runtimeErr error
102		runtimeDone := false
103		join := func(row *tui.RepoRow) {
104			row.Context.TaskErr = tasksErr
105			if row.Unavailable != "" {
106				return
107			}
108			row.Pending = "runtime pending"
109			if runtimeDone {
110				if runtimeErr != nil {
111					row.Context.RuntimeErr = runtimeErr
112					row.Pending = "runtime unavailable"
113				} else {
114					joinRuntime(row, runtimeSnapshot)
115					row.Pending = ""
116				}
117			}
118			if row.Favorite() && row.Repo.HasGit && !row.Repo.Bare && !row.GitKnown {
119				// Status failure is not proof that this navigation target disappeared.
120				// Keep observation-dependent actions pending; open revalidates identity.
121				row.Pending = "Git observation unavailable"
122			}
123		}
124		for {
125			if ctx.Err() != nil {
126				return nil, errors.Join(err, ctx.Err())
127			}
128			if !acquiring && len(favorites)+len(ordinary) > 0 {
129				acquiring = true
130				workers.Go(func() {
131					release, ok := limiter.Acquire(workerCtx)
132					if !ok {
133						return
134					}
135					select {
136					case permits <- release:
137					case <-workerCtx.Done():
138						release()
139					}
140				})
141			}
142			if discoveryReady == nil && runtimeDone && active == 0 && !acquiring && len(favorites)+len(ordinary) == 0 {
143				break
144			}
145			select {
146			case <-ctx.Done():
147				return nil, errors.Join(err, ctx.Err())
148			case <-discoveryReady:
149				discoveryReady = nil
150				err = errors.Join(err, repositories.err)
151				pending = append(pending, repositories.value...)
152				admitDiscovered()
153			case <-runtimeReady:
154				runtimeReady, runtimeDone = nil, true
155				runtimeSnapshot, runtimeErr = live.value, live.err
156				err = errors.Join(err, runtimeErr)
157				for i := range records {
158					if records[i].complete && records[i].row.Repo.Path != "" && records[i].row.Unavailable == "" {
159						join(&records[i].row)
160						publish("runtime", records[i].row)
161					}
162				}
163			case release := <-permits:
164				acquiring = false
165				var job tuiRepoJob
166				if len(favorites) > 0 {
167					job, favorites = favorites[0], favorites[1:]
168				} else {
169					job, ordinary = ordinary[0], ordinary[1:]
170				}
171				active++
172				workers.Go(func() {
173					defer release()
174					result := tuiRepoDone{job: job, row: job.row}
175					if job.validate {
176						result.row.Repo, result.err = validate(workerCtx, job.row.Repo)
177						if result.err == nil {
178							// Keep the admitted slot through validation and enrichment.
179							// Only identity arbitration returns to the dispatcher.
180							result.proceed = make(chan bool, 1)
181							select {
182							case completed <- result:
183							case <-workerCtx.Done():
184								return
185							}
186							select {
187							case proceed := <-result.proceed:
188								if !proceed {
189									return
190								}
191							case <-workerCtx.Done():
192								return
193							}
194							result.proceed, result.job.validate = nil, false
195							result.row = collect(workerCtx, result.row)
196						}
197					} else {
198						result.row = collect(workerCtx, job.row)
199					}
200					select {
201					case completed <- result:
202					case <-workerCtx.Done():
203					}
204				})
205			case result := <-completed:
206				if result.proceed == nil {
207					active--
208				}
209				index, row := result.job.index, result.row
210				if result.job.validate {
211					for _, key := range tuiRepoKeys(result.job.row.Repo) {
212						reserved[key]--
213					}
214					if result.err != nil {
215						row = result.job.row
216						row.Pending, row.Unavailable = "unavailable", result.err.Error()
217						err = errors.Join(err, fmt.Errorf("favorite %s: %w", row.Repo.Path, result.err))
218						// A replaced checkout at this path must not overwrite the
219						// unavailable favorite with an apparently clean observation.
220						for path := range canonicalRepoValues(row.Repo.Path) {
221							known["path:"+path], owners["path:"+path] = true, index
222						}
223						records[index] = tuiRepoRecord{row: row, complete: true}
224						publish("enrichment", row)
225					} else {
226						keys, duplicate := tuiRepoKeys(row.Repo), false
227						for _, key := range keys {
228							duplicate = duplicate || known[key]
229						}
230						if duplicate {
231							records[index] = tuiRepoRecord{}
232							active--
233							result.proceed <- false
234						} else {
235							for _, key := range keys {
236								known[key], owners[key] = true, index
237							}
238							records[index].row = row
239							result.proceed <- true
240						}
241					}
242					admitDiscovered()
243					continue
244				}
245				if row.Favorite() && row.Repo.HasGit && !row.Repo.Bare && !row.GitKnown {
246					reason := "repository Git observation unavailable"
247					if main, ok := row.Context.Main(); ok && main.StatusErr != nil {
248						reason = main.StatusErr.Error()
249					}
250					err = errors.Join(err, fmt.Errorf("favorite %s: %s", row.Repo.Path, reason))
251				}
252				preferTUIRepoAlias(&row, records[index].row.Repo)
253				join(&row)
254				records[index] = tuiRepoRecord{row: row, complete: true}
255				publish("enrichment", row)
256			}
257		}
258		rows := make([]tui.RepoRow, 0, len(records))
259		for _, record := range records {
260			if record.complete && record.row.Repo.Path != "" {
261				rows = append(rows, record.row)
262			}
263		}
264		return rows, err
265	}

16	)

18	// prepareRepoRowCollector reads shared inputs once. Admission and the shared
19	// limiter belong to callers, not to one goroutine per repository.
20	func prepareRepoRowCollector(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, options repoCollectOptions) (func(context.Context, tui.RepoRow) tui.RepoRow, error) {
21		tasks := options.Tasks
22		var taskInventoryErr error
23		if !options.TasksSet {
24			var diagnostics []task.Diagnostic
25			var err error
26			tasks, diagnostics, err = app.Tasks.ListWithDiagnostics()
27			if err != nil {
28				return nil, err
29			}
30			for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
31				taskInventoryErr = errors.Join(taskInventoryErr, diagnostic)
32			}
33		}
34		byRepo := map[string][]*task.Task{}
35		for _, tracked := range tasks {
36			byRepo[tracked.RepoPath] = append(byRepo[tracked.RepoPath], tracked)
37		}
38		sessions, runtimeErr := options.Sessions, options.SessionsErr
39		if !options.SessionsSet {
40			sessions, runtimeErr = rt.List(ctx)
41		}
42		notesByRepo := map[string][]*note.Note{}
43		if app.Notes != nil {
44			allNotes, err := app.Notes.List("")
45			if err != nil {
46				return nil, err
47			}
48			for _, n := range allNotes {
49				notesByRepo[n.RepositoryID] = append(notesByRepo[n.RepositoryID], n)
50			}
51		}
52		return func(ctx context.Context, row tui.RepoRow) tui.RepoRow {
53			r := row.Repo
54			row.ObservedAt = time.Now()
55			if row.Asset != nil {
56				repoNotes := notesByRepo[row.Asset.ID]
57				row.NoteCount = len(repoNotes)
58				if len(repoNotes) > 0 {
59					row.LatestNote = repoNotes[0]
60				}
61			}
62			if r.HasGit {
63				if options.DeferTopology {
64					row.TopologyPending = true
65					row.TopologyErr = errors.New("recovery details not loaded")
66				} else {
67					row.Topology, row.TopologyErr = gitx.RecoveryTopologyOf(ctx, r.Path)
68				}
69			}
70			row.Tasks = append(row.Tasks, byRepo[r.Path]...)
71			if r.RealPath != "" && r.RealPath != r.Path {
72				row.Tasks = append(row.Tasks, byRepo[r.RealPath]...)
73			}
74			row.Context = inventory.CollectRepoContext(ctx, r, row.Tasks, sessions, rt.Name())
75			row.Context.TaskErr = taskInventoryErr
76			row.Context.RuntimeErr = runtimeErr
77			row.LastActivity, row.Worktrees = row.Context.LastActivity, row.Context.WorktreeCount
78			if main, ok := row.Context.Main(); ok {
79				row.Status = main.Status
80				row.GitKnown = main.StatusErr == nil && main.Exists && main.PathErr == nil && !main.Worktree.Prunable
81			}
82			if !r.Bare {
83				row.RemoteForge, row.RemoteName = forge.IdentityFromURL(gitx.RemoteFromConfig(r.CommonDir, "origin"))
84			}
85			if live := row.Context.Sessions(); len(live) > 0 {
86				row.Live, row.Runtime = true, rt.Name()
87				row.RuntimeHandle, row.RuntimeStatus = live[0].Handle, live[0].AgentStatus
88			}
89			if r.HasGit {
90				row.SizeTarget = diskusage.FromGit(gitx.Repo{
91					Root: r.Path, GitDir: r.GitDir, GitCommonDir: r.CommonDir,
92					MainRoot: r.MainRoot, Name: r.Name, Bare: r.Bare,
93				}, row.Worktrees)
94			} else {
95				row.SizeTarget = diskusage.Plain(r.Path)
96			}
97			return row
98		}, nil
99	}

10	// LocalLoadRequest identifies the three view generations sharing one source
11	// snapshot. Each result remains independently replaceable.
12	type LocalLoadRequest struct {
13		CycleGeneration uint64
14		TasksGeneration uint64
15		ReposGeneration uint64
16		TriesGeneration uint64
17		ShowAllTries    bool
18		ForceSizes      bool
19	}
20	
21	// LocalResult is one terminal TASKS, REPOS, or TRY snapshot.
22	type LocalResult struct {
23		Phase      string
24		View       View
25		Generation uint64
26		Tasks      []inventory.Row
27		Repos      []RepoRow
28		Tries      []TryRow
29		Valid      bool
30		Err        error
31	}
32	
33	// LocalLoad is a cancellable stream owned by the caller's context.
34	type LocalLoad struct {
35		ID      uint64
36		Request LocalLoadRequest
37		Results <-chan LocalResult
38	}
39	
40	// LocalActions starts one shared local source cycle.
41	type LocalActions struct {
42		Start func(context.Context, LocalLoadRequest) LocalLoad
43	}
44	
45	type localMsg struct {
46		load   LocalLoad
47		result LocalResult
48		done   bool
49	}
50	
51	func (m Model) startLocalLoad() tea.Cmd {
52		if m.actions.Local.Start == nil {
53			return nil
54		}
55		request := LocalLoadRequest{
56			CycleGeneration: m.localGeneration,
57			TasksGeneration: m.viewLoad(ViewTasks).generation,
58			ReposGeneration: m.viewLoad(ViewRepos).generation,
59			TriesGeneration: m.viewLoad(ViewTries).generation,
60			ShowAllTries:    m.showAllTries,
61			ForceSizes:      m.forceSizeReload,
62		}
63		load := m.actions.Local.Start(m.localReadContext(), request)
64		load.Request = request
65		if load.ID == 0 || load.Results == nil {
66			return nil
67		}
68		return waitForLocal(load)
69	}
70	
71	func waitForLocal(load LocalLoad) tea.Cmd {
72		return func() tea.Msg {
73			result, ok := <-load.Results
74			if !ok {
75				return localMsg{load: load, done: true}
76			}
77			return localMsg{load: load, result: result}
78		}
79	}
80	
81	func (m Model) applyLocalResult(result LocalResult) (Model, bool) {
82		accepted := false
83		if result.View == ViewRepos && result.Phase != "" {
84			return m.applyRepoProgress(result)
85		}
86		token := m.currentToken()
87		path := m.repoFocusPath()
88		switch result.View {
89		case ViewTasks:
90			accepted = m.applyViewResult(
91				ViewTasks, result.Generation, result.Valid, "live", resultFreshness(result.Err),
92				len(result.Tasks), result.Err, result.Valid,
93			)
94			if accepted && result.Valid {
95				m.rows = append([]inventory.Row(nil), result.Tasks...)
96			}
97		case ViewRepos:
98			accepted = m.applyViewResult(
99				ViewRepos, result.Generation, result.Valid, "live", resultFreshness(result.Err),
100				len(result.Repos), result.Err, result.Valid,
101			)
102			if accepted && result.Valid {
103				m.setViewStatus(ViewRepos, "")
104				m.acceptCompleteRepoSnapshot(result.Err)
105				if result.Err != nil {
106					m.repos = mergeRepoProgress(m.repos, result.Repos)
107				} else {
108					m.repos = completeRepoRows(m.repos, result.Repos)
109				}
110				m.repoProgressPhase = 3
111				m.matchRemoteLocals()
112			}
113		case ViewTries:
114			accepted = m.applyViewResult(
115				ViewTries, result.Generation, result.Valid, "live", resultFreshness(result.Err),
116				len(result.Tries), result.Err, result.Valid,
117			)
118			if accepted && result.Valid {
119				m.tries = append([]TryRow(nil), result.Tries...)
120				m.matchRemoteLocals()
121			}
122		}
123		m.restoreRepoFocus(token, path)
124		m.setAt(m.at())
125		return m, accepted
126	}

1	package tui

3	import (
4		"fmt"

7	
8	func mergeRepoProgress(previous, updates []RepoRow) []RepoRow {
9		rows := append([]RepoRow(nil), previous...)
10		for _, row := range updates {
11			found := false
12			for i, old := range rows {
13				if old.Repo.Path == row.Repo.Path || sameFavoriteRepository(old.Repo, row.Repo) {
14					if (row.Pending == "loading" && old.Pending != "loading" && old.Pending != "refreshing") ||
15						(row.Pending == "cached" && old.Pending != "cached" && old.Pending != "refreshing") {
16						if row.Asset != nil && (old.Asset == nil || !old.Asset.Updated.After(row.Asset.Updated)) {
17							rows[i].Asset = row.Asset.Clone()
18						}
19						found = true
20						break
21					}
22					if row.Asset == nil && (row.Pending == "loading" || row.Pending == "cached") && sameFavoriteRepository(old.Repo, row.Repo) {
23						row.Asset = old.Asset
24					}
25					if row.TopologyPending && !old.TopologyPending && old.Pending == "" {
26						row.Topology, row.TopologyErr, row.TopologyPending = old.Topology, old.TopologyErr, false
27					}
28					if row.Usage == nil {
29						row.Usage, row.SizeError = old.Usage, old.SizeError
30					}
31					rows[i] = row
32					found = true
33					break
34				}
35			}
36			if !found {
37				rows = append(rows, row)
38			}
39		}
40		return rows
41	}
42	
43	func (m Model) applyRepoProgress(result LocalResult) (Model, bool) {
44		state := m.viewLoad(ViewRepos)
45		if result.Generation != state.generation || m.repoProgressPhase == 3 {
46			return m, false
47		}
48		phase := 1
49		if result.Phase == "favorites" {
50			// Provisional intent can precede the cache without making the cache's
51			// other rows obsolete. Per-row merging protects richer observations.
52			phase = max(phase, m.repoProgressPhase)
53		} else if result.Phase != "cache" {
54			phase = 2
55		}
56		if phase < m.repoProgressPhase {
57			return m, false
58		}
59		m.repoProgressPhase = phase
60		token := m.currentToken()
61		path := m.repoFocusPath()
62		m.repos = mergeRepoProgress(m.repos, result.Repos)
63		m.loads[int(ViewRepos)].hasSnapshot = true
64		m.loads[int(ViewRepos)].freshness = perftrace.FreshnessStale
65		m.loads[int(ViewRepos)].actionable = false
66		m.loads[int(ViewRepos)].source = perftrace.SourceLive
67		if result.Phase == "cache" {
68			m.loads[int(ViewRepos)].source = perftrace.SourceCache
69		}
70		count := len(m.repos)
71		m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewSnapshotAccepted, perftrace.Fields{View: perftrace.ViewRepos, Stage: perftrace.StageFirstEnrichment, Source: m.loads[int(ViewRepos)].source, Freshness: perftrace.FreshnessStale, Generation: result.Generation, Rows: &count})
72		message := fmt.Sprintf("Refreshing local repositories… %d visible", count)
73		if result.Phase == "cache" && len(result.Repos) > 0 {
74			message = "Cached " + result.Repos[0].ObservedAt.Local().Format("Jan 2 15:04") + " · " + message
75		}
76		m.setViewStatus(ViewRepos, message)
77		m.restoreRepoFocus(token, path)
78		m.setAt(m.at())
79		return m, true
80	}
81	
82	func (m Model) repoFocusPath() string {
83		if item, ok := m.currentRepoItem(); ok {
84			if checkout, child := item.checkout(); child {
85				return checkout.Worktree.Path
86			}
87			return item.Repo.Repo.Path
88		}
89		return ""
90	}
91	func (m *Model) restoreRepoFocus(token selectionToken, path string) {
92		if m.selectToken(token) || m.view != ViewRepos || path == "" {
93			return
94		}
95		for i, item := range m.visibleRepoItems() {
96			candidate := item.Repo.Repo.Path
97			if checkout, child := item.checkout(); child {
98				candidate = checkout.Worktree.Path
99			}
100			if candidate == path {
101				m.setAt(i)
102				return
103			}
104		}
105	}
106	
107	func completeRepoRows(previous, rows []RepoRow) []RepoRow {
108		merged := mergeRepoProgress(previous, rows)
109		out := make([]RepoRow, 0, len(rows))
110		for _, row := range rows {
111			for _, candidate := range merged {
112				if row.Repo.Path == candidate.Repo.Path || sameFavoriteRepository(row.Repo, candidate.Repo) {
113					out = append(out, candidate)
114					break
115				}
116			}
117		}
118		return out
119	}

14	// SizeActions is the asynchronous disk-usage boundary injected by cli.runTUI.
15	type SizeActions struct {
16		Invalidate func(...diskusage.Target) error
17		Start      func(ctx context.Context, targets []diskusage.Target, force bool) diskusage.Load
18		Cancel     func(loadID uint64)
19	}

21	type sizeMsg struct {
22		loadID uint64

32	func (m Model) updateSize(msg sizeMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
33		if msg.loadID == 0 {
34			return m, nil
35		}
36		load := m.sizeLoad
37		index := -1
38		if load.ID != msg.loadID {
39			for n, other := range m.scopedSizeLoads {
40				if other.ID == msg.loadID {
41					load, index = other, n
42					break
43				}
44			}
45			if index < 0 {
46				return m, nil
47			}
48		}
49		if msg.done {
50			if index < 0 {
51				m.sizeLoad = diskusage.Load{}
52			} else {
53				m.scopedSizeLoads = slices.Delete(slices.Clone(m.scopedSizeLoads), index, index+1)
54			}
55			return m, nil
56		}
57		for _, owner := range m.sizeOwners {
58			if owner.key == msg.result.Key && owner.loadID != msg.loadID {
59				return m, waitForSize(load)
60			}
61		}
62		m.applySizeResult(msg.result)
63		return m, waitForSize(load)
64	}
65	
66	func (m *Model) setSizeOwner(key string, id uint64) {
67		if key == "" {
68			return
69		}
70		m.sizeOwners = slices.Clone(m.sizeOwners)
71		for n := range m.sizeOwners {
72			if m.sizeOwners[n].key == key {
73				m.sizeOwners[n].loadID = id
74				return
75			}
76		}
77		m.sizeOwners = append(m.sizeOwners, sizeOwner{key, id})
78	}

80	func (m Model) beginScopedSizes(targets, invalidated []diskusage.Target) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
81		for _, target := range invalidated {
82			m.setSizeOwner(target.Key, 0)
83		}
84		if m.actions.Sizes.Start == nil || len(targets) == 0 {
85			return m, nil
86		}
87		load := m.actions.Sizes.Start(m.baseContext(), targets, true)
88		if load.ID == 0 || load.Results == nil {
89			return m, nil
90		}
91		m.scopedSizeLoads = append(slices.Clone(m.scopedSizeLoads), load)
92		for _, target := range targets {
93			m.setSizeOwner(target.Key, load.ID)
94		}

98	func (m Model) beginSizeLoad(force bool) (Model, tea.Cmd) {
99		if m.actions.Sizes.Start == nil {
100			return m, nil
101		}
102		if m.sizeLoad.ID != 0 && m.actions.Sizes.Cancel != nil {
103			m.actions.Sizes.Cancel(m.sizeLoad.ID)
104		}
105		for _, load := range m.scopedSizeLoads {
106			if m.actions.Sizes.Cancel != nil {
107				m.actions.Sizes.Cancel(load.ID)
108			}
109		}
110		m.scopedSizeLoads, m.sizeOwners = nil, nil
111		targets := make([]diskusage.Target, 0, len(m.repos)+len(m.tries))
112		for _, row := range m.repos {

117		for _, row := range m.tries {

122		m.sizeLoad = m.actions.Sizes.Start(m.baseContext(), targets, force)
123		if m.sizeLoad.ID == 0 || m.sizeLoad.Results == nil {

168	func matchesSize(usage *diskusage.Usage, expression string) bool {
169		if usage == nil {
170			return false
171		}
172		expression = strings.TrimSpace(expression)
173		operator := "="
174		for _, candidate := range []string{">=", "<=", ">", "<", "="} {
175			if strings.HasPrefix(expression, candidate) {
176				operator = candidate
177				expression = strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(expression, candidate))
178				break
179			}
180		}
181		bytes, err := humanize.ParseBytes(expression)
182		if err != nil {
183			return false
184		}
185		owned := uint64(max(usage.OwnedBytes, 0))
186		switch operator {
187		case ">=":
188			return owned >= bytes
189		case "<=":
190			return owned <= bytes
191		case ">":
192			return owned > bytes
193		case "<":
194			return owned < bytes
195		default:
196			return owned == bytes
197		}
198	}
199	
200	func sizeDetailLines(usage *diskusage.Usage, err error, target diskusage.Target) []string {
201		if target.Checkout == "" {
202			return nil
203		}
204		if err != nil {
205			return []string{fmt.Sprintf("  %s  %s", styleDim.Render("size"), styleErr.Render(err.Error()))}
206		}
207		if usage == nil {
208			return []string{fmt.Sprintf("  %s  %s", styleDim.Render("size"), styleDim.Render("measuring…"))}
209		}
210		lines := []string{
211			fmt.Sprintf("  %s  %s logical owned", styleDim.Render("size"), usage.HumanOwned()),
212			fmt.Sprintf("  %s  %s", styleDim.Render("checkout"), humanize.IBytes(uint64(max(usage.CheckoutBytes, 0)))),
213		}
214		if usage.PrivateGitBytes != nil {
215			lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("  %s  %s", styleDim.Render("private .git"),
216				humanize.IBytes(uint64(max(*usage.PrivateGitBytes, 0)))))
217		}
218		if usage.SharedGitBytes != nil {
219			lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("  %s  %s (not reclaimable with this checkout)",
220				styleDim.Render("shared .git"), humanize.IBytes(uint64(max(*usage.SharedGitBytes, 0)))))
221		}
222		if !usage.Complete {
223			lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("  %s  partial; %d unreadable entries", styleDim.Render("measure"), usage.UnreadableEntries))
224		}
225		return lines
226	}

# REPOS 初次載入順暢度：穩定排序、批次套用、快取排序提示

## Context

使用者回報：開啟 dashboard 進入 REPOS（106 repos）時，背景掃描（Git 狀態、Herdr 狀態、latest、size）陸續回來，列表不斷重排、SIZE 欄位 `—` → `…` → 數值 閃動，體驗不順。

已追出的成因（皆已讀碼確認）：

- **排序鍵在串流期間一直變**：`internal/tui/model.go` `visibleRepos` 每次 render 都用 `compareRepos` 重排；預設 `activity` 的鍵依序是 HotTasks → Live → Dirty → len(Tasks) → LastActivity → name。快取列（`Pending=="cached"`，來自 `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/dev/repos-v1.json`）只有 Repo/Status/LastActivity，**沒有 Tasks/Live/Worktrees**，所以每筆 `enrichment`（補上 tasks）與 `runtime`（Herdr `rt.List` 回來後補上 Live）訊息都會改變該列的排序鍵，列就往上跳。
- **沒有訊息合併**：`internal/cli/tui_repo_load.go` `collectTUIRepoStream` 對每個 repo 各 publish 一筆 `enrichment`、再一筆 `runtime`；`internal/tui/local.go` `waitForLocal` 一次只收一筆 → 一次 Update/render。106 repos ≈ 200+ 次重排與重繪。
- **SIZE 起步晚**：`beginSizeLoad` 只在整個 local load `done` 後才啟動（`model.go` localMsg done 分支）；快取列沒有 `SizeTarget` 所以顯示 `—`，enrichment 後變 `…`，等 `sizeMsg` 才有值。diskusage 本身有 TTL 快取（`internal/diskusage/cache.go`），命中是即時的，只是啟動點太晚。
- 游標已依 path 保留（`applyRepoProgress` → `restoreRepoFocus`），這部分不是問題來源。

（實作步驟待設計結果補齊）

1	package repo

14	)
15	
16	// CachedRow holds presentation only: no task, runtime or action authority.
17	type CachedRow struct {
18		Repo         Repo
19		Status       gitx.Status
20		GitKnown     bool
21		LastActivity time.Time
22		Try          bool
23	}
24	type Snapshot struct {
25		Version     int
26		Fingerprint [32]byte
27		ObservedAt  time.Time
28		Rows        []CachedRow
29	}
30	
31	func SnapshotKey(roots []string, state string) [32]byte {
32		data, _ := json.Marshal(struct {
33			Roots []string
34			State string
35		}{roots, state})
36		return sha256.Sum256(data)
37	}
38	func ReadSnapshot(ctx context.Context, path string, key [32]byte) (Snapshot, error) {
39		data, err := safefile.ReadRegular(ctx, path, 8<<20)
40		if err != nil {
41			return Snapshot{}, err
42		}
43		var snapshot Snapshot
44		if err = json.Unmarshal(data, &snapshot); err != nil {
45			return Snapshot{}, err
46		}
47		if snapshot.Version != 1 || snapshot.Fingerprint != key || snapshot.ObservedAt.IsZero() {
48			return Snapshot{}, errors.New("repository cache does not match this discovery configuration")
49		}
50		for _, r := range snapshot.Rows {
51			if !filepath.IsAbs(r.Repo.Path) || r.Repo.Name == "" {
52				return Snapshot{}, errors.New("invalid cached repository")
53			}
54		}
55		return snapshot, nil
56	}
57	func WriteSnapshot(path string, snapshot Snapshot) error {
58		snapshot.Version = 1
59		data, err := json.Marshal(snapshot)
60		if err != nil {
61			return err
62		}
63		if len(data) > 8<<20 {
64			return errors.New("repository cache exceeds 8 MiB")
65		}
66		if err = os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0700); err != nil {
67			return err
68		}
69		file, err := os.CreateTemp(filepath.Dir(path), ".repos-*")
70		if err != nil {
71			return err
72		}
73		defer os.Remove(file.Name())
74		if _, err = file.Write(data); err != nil {
75			file.Close()
76			return err
77		}
78		if err = file.Close(); err != nil {
79			return err
80		}
81		return os.Rename(file.Name(), path)
82	}
83

1	package diskusage
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"sync"
6		"sync/atomic"
7	)
8	
9	// ScanFunc is the measurement seam used by Manager tests.
10	type ScanFunc func(context.Context, Target) (Usage, error)
11	
12	// Result is one streamed row measurement.
13	type Result struct {
14		LoadID uint64
15		Key    string
16		Usage  Usage
17		Err    error
18	}
19	
20	// Load is a cancellable stream. Results closes after every unique target is
21	// delivered or the context is cancelled.
22	type Load struct {
23		ID      uint64
24		Results <-chan Result
25	}
26	
27	// Manager bounds scans and shares one derived cache across CLI and TUI callers.
28	type Manager struct {
29		Cache   *Cache
30		Workers int
31		Scan    ScanFunc
32	
33		next atomic.Uint64
34		mu   sync.Mutex
35		stop map[uint64]context.CancelFunc
36	}
37	
38	// NewManager returns a manager with portable scanner defaults.
39	func NewManager(cache *Cache, workers int) *Manager {
40		if workers <= 0 {
41			workers = 2
42		}
43		return &Manager{Cache: cache, Workers: workers, Scan: Scan, stop: map[uint64]context.CancelFunc{}}
44	}
45	
46	// Measure returns one cache hit or fresh scan.
47	func (m *Manager) Measure(ctx context.Context, target Target, force bool) (Usage, error) {
48		if ctx == nil {
49			ctx = context.Background()
50		}
51		if !force && m != nil && m.Cache != nil {
52			if usage, ok, _ := m.Cache.Get(target); ok {
53				return usage, nil
54			}
55		}
56		scanner := ScanFunc(Scan)
57		if m != nil && m.Scan != nil {
58			scanner = m.Scan
59		}
60		usage, err := scanner(ctx, target)
61		if err != nil {
62			return Usage{}, err
63		}
64		if m != nil && m.Cache != nil {
65			_ = m.Cache.Set(target, usage)
66		}
67		return usage, nil
68	}
69	
70	// Start streams unique targets through a bounded worker pool.
71	func (m *Manager) Start(parent context.Context, targets []Target, force bool) Load {
72		if parent == nil {
73			parent = context.Background()
74		}
75		if m == nil {
76			results := make(chan Result)
77			close(results)
78			return Load{Results: results}
79		}
80		id := m.next.Add(1)
81		ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(parent)
82		m.mu.Lock()
83		if m.stop == nil {
84			m.stop = map[uint64]context.CancelFunc{}
85		}
86		m.stop[id] = cancel
87		m.mu.Unlock()
88	
89		unique := make([]Target, 0, len(targets))
90		seen := map[string]struct{}{}
91		for _, target := range targets {
92			key := targetKey(target)
93			if _, ok := seen[key]; ok {
94				continue
95			}
96			seen[key] = struct{}{}
97			target.Key = key
98			unique = append(unique, target)
99		}
100		results := make(chan Result, len(unique))
101		load := Load{ID: id, Results: results}
102		go m.run(ctx, cancel, load, unique, force, results)
103		return load
104	}
105	
106	func (m *Manager) run(ctx context.Context, cancel context.CancelFunc, load Load, targets []Target, force bool, results chan<- Result) {
107		defer close(results)
108		defer cancel()
109		defer func() {
110			m.mu.Lock()
111			delete(m.stop, load.ID)
112			m.mu.Unlock()
113		}()
114	
115		jobs := make(chan Target)
116		workers := m.Workers
117		if workers <= 0 {
118			workers = 2
119		}
120		if workers > len(targets) {
121			workers = len(targets)
122		}
123		if workers == 0 {
124			return
125		}
126		var wait sync.WaitGroup
127		wait.Add(workers)
128		for range workers {
129			go func() {
130				defer wait.Done()
131				for {
132					var target Target
133					var ok bool
134					select {
135					case <-ctx.Done():
136						return
137					case target, ok = <-jobs:
138						if !ok {
139							return
140						}
141					}
142					if ctx.Err() != nil {
143						return
144					}
145					usage, err := m.Measure(ctx, target, force)
146					if ctx.Err() != nil {
147						return
148					}
149					result := Result{LoadID: load.ID, Key: target.Key, Usage: usage, Err: err}
150					select {
151					case results <- result:
152					case <-ctx.Done():
153						return
154					}
155				}
156			}()
157		}
158		for _, target := range targets {
159			if ctx.Err() != nil {
160				close(jobs)
161				wait.Wait()
162				return
163			}
164			select {
165			case jobs <- target:
166			case <-ctx.Done():
167				close(jobs)
168				wait.Wait()
169				return
170			}
171		}
172		close(jobs)
173		wait.Wait()
174		if m.Cache != nil {
175			_ = m.Cache.Save()
176		}
177	}
178	
179	// Cancel stops one active load. It is safe after completion.
180	func (m *Manager) Cancel(id uint64) {
181		if m == nil || id == 0 {
182			return
183		}
184		m.mu.Lock()
185		cancel := m.stop[id]
186		m.mu.Unlock()
187		if cancel != nil {
188			cancel()
189		}
190	}
191	
192	// Invalidate drops cached ownership layouts changed by a local mutation.
193	func (m *Manager) Invalidate(targets ...Target) error {
194		if m == nil || m.Cache == nil {
195			return nil
196		}
197		return m.Cache.Invalidate(targets...)
198	}
199
```

I traced the whole REPOS load path. Rows jump because the sort runs again on every render and its keys fill in piece by piece. The default `activity` sort uses hot tasks, then live runtime, then dirty Git status, then task count, then latest commit, then name. The first rows come from a cache that has none of the task or runtime data. Those fields then arrive one repo at a time, each in its own message, so a row moves every time one of its keys changes.

## 1. Initial load sequence

**Startup wiring.** `runTUI` in `/Users/zhouhanru/Documents/David/Program/dev-cli/internal/cli/tui.go:754` builds the model with `tui.New(actions, nil, nil)...BeginLoading()`. Nothing is loaded before the screen appears.
- `BeginLoading` (`internal/tui/model.go:588`) sets `initialLoad = true` and calls `beginLocalLoads(loadInitial)` (`internal/tui/readiness.go:125`). That bumps `localGeneration` and the TASKS, REPOS and TRY view generations.
- `Init` (`model.go:610`) batches several commands: `textinput.Blink`, `readStartupRepo()` (which returns `startupRepoMsg`), and `m.reload()`. It also batches tool and ghdash probes, the remote cache, fleet loading, the release check and `runAfterFirstView`.
- In production `m.reload()` (`model.go:933`) goes to `startLocalLoad()` (`internal/tui/local.go:51`), because `Local.Start` is set to `localLoader.Start` (`cli/tui.go:545`). The older single-message `reloadMsg` path is only the fallback.

**The loader.** `tuiLocalLoader.Start` is in `/Users/zhouhanru/Documents/David/Program/dev-cli/internal/cli/tui_load.go:77`. It returns a buffered channel (`make(chan tui.LocalResult, 16)`). Four background jobs start at once:
- `catalogState`, which reads catalog favorites and assets via `readTUIRepoCatalog` (`cli/tui_repo_seeds.go:25`)
- `tasks`, which lists tasks
- `runtimeState`, which resolves the runtime and runs `rt.List(ctx)` once. This is where Herdr/LIVE data comes from (`tui_load.go:110-128`)
- `repositories`, which runs `repo.Discover`. Its `OnCandidate` callback sends a `Phase: "discovery"` row with `Pending: "loading"` for each repo found (`tui_load.go:146-160`)

**The REPOS producer** (`tui_load.go:218-289`) emits phases in this order:
1. **`"favorites"`**: catalog seed rows (`metadata.seeds`, `Pending: "loading"`) as one batch (`:224`).
2. **`"cache"`**: one batch read from `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/dev/repos-v1.json` (`:96`, `:227-238`). Each cached row has only `Repo`, `Status`, `LastActivity`, `GitKnown` and `Asset`, with `Pending: "cached"`. It has **no Tasks, no Live/runtime, no Worktrees and no Usage**. The cache has no TTL; it is rejected only if the version or fingerprint differs (`internal/repo/cache.go:47`). After this batch, `close(presentationReady)` lets discovery candidates start flowing.
3. **`"discovery"`**: one message per candidate repo.
4. **`"enrichment"`**: one message per repo, from `collectTUIRepoStream` (`cli/tui_repo_load.go:35`).
   - Work goes through `inventory.NewLimiter(8)`, favorites first (`:166-170`).
   - Each row is filled by `prepareRepoRowCollector` (`cli/tui_repo_collect.go:20`). It is called with `runtime.None{}` and `SessionsErr: "runtime observation pending"` (`tui_load.go:246-249`), and topology is deferred.
   - Enrichment fills Git status, `LastActivity` (latest commit), `Worktrees`, `Tasks`, notes and `SizeTarget` (`tui_repo_collect.go:70-96`).
   - `join()` (`tui_repo_load.go:103`) sets `Pending = "runtime pending"` until the runtime result is in. After that it calls `joinRuntime` (`tui_load.go:315`), which sets `Live`, `RuntimeHandle` and `RuntimeStatus`.
5. **`"runtime"`**: when `runtimeReady` fires (`tui_repo_load.go:153-162`), every repo already completed is re-joined and **published again, one message per row**. Rows enriched after that point get runtime data inside their `"enrichment"` message.
6. **Terminal result (`Phase: ""`)**: the full list (`tui_load.go:288`), after `repos-v1.json` has been rewritten (`:281-287`).
7. **Channel close**: this produces `localMsg{done: true}`.

**Size (diskusage) starts only after the whole local stream has finished.** In the `localMsg` handler, `done` leads to `finishLocalLoad()` and then `beginSizeLoad(request.ForceSizes)` (`model.go:2549-2559`). `beginSizeLoad` (`internal/tui/size.go:98`) cancels any earlier loads, collects every `SizeTarget` from `m.repos` and `m.tries`, and calls `Sizes.Start`.

**Topology.** This is not part of the bulk load. It is fetched only for the currently selected row, through `repoTopologyMsg`, from `Model.Update` (`internal/tui/repo_topology.go:82-102`).

**Startup repo.** `startupRepoMsg` (`model.go:2428`) loads in parallel. `focusStartupRepo` (`startup_repo.go:70`) moves `repoCursor` to the repo you launched from, the first time that repo shows up in the list.

## 2. Sort logic

The sort lives in `visibleRepos()` (`model.go:1286-1309`) and runs in three passes:
1. `sort.SliceStable` using `compareRepos(a, b, m.actions.RepoSort)`. An empty sort means `"activity"`, and `RepoReverse` flips it.
2. `applyColumnSort(m, out, repoCell)` (`table.go:143`), applied only when a column header sort is active. Rows with unknown values go last.
3. `sort.SliceStable(out, ... out[i].Favorite() && !out[j].Favorite())`, so **favorites are always on top**. Favorite state includes your pending toggles, via `withRepoFavorite` (`repo_favorite.go:62`).

`compareRepos` is at `model.go:1613-1694`:

```go
default: // activity
    descInt(a.HotTasks(), b.HotTasks())      // hot tasks
    descBool(a.Live, b.Live)                 // live runtime (Herdr)
    descBool(a.Status.Dirty(), b.Status.Dirty())
    descInt(len(a.Tasks), len(b.Tasks))
    latest()                                 // LastActivity desc
// final tie-break: nameCmp
```

The other sort modes:

| Mode | Key |
|---|---|
| `latest` | `LastActivity` |
| `git` | dirty, then changed count |
| `size` | `Usage != nil` first, then `OwnedBytes` descending |
| `tasks` | hot tasks, then total tasks |
| `name` | name |

The `O` key cycles through `activity, latest, name, git, size, tasks` (`action_shortcuts.go:112-115`).

**When re-sorting happens:** there is no cached sorted list. `visibleRepos()` runs again on every `View()`, `count()`, `currentRepoItem()`, `restoreRepoFocus` and `setAt`. Every message the program receives triggers a re-render, so the list is re-sorted after every single message.

**Why rows jump under `activity`, step by step:**
- **Cache phase:** cached rows have `Tasks == nil` and `Live == false`. The order is effectively dirty, then latest, then name.
- **Discovery:** repos not in the cache appear with empty values and sort near the bottom. Repos already in the cache keep their cached data, because `mergeRepoProgress` (`repo_progress.go:14-21`) refuses to replace a cached row with a `"loading"` one.
- **Enrichment, one repo at a time:** `Tasks` arrive (hot tasks is the first sort key), and so do fresh `Status` and `LastActivity`. Each message can move that one row a long way up.
- **Runtime:** all completed rows are re-published one message at a time with `Live` set. The live key moves each live repo above idle ones, one by one.
- **Terminal snapshot:** `completeRepoRows` drops rows that are not in the final list.
- **Size:** this only reorders anything when the sort is `size` or a SIZE column sort is active. Then every `sizeMsg` moves one row.

## 3. How async results arrive

**Local stream:** results come **per repo** for discovery, enrichment and runtime. Favorites, cache and the terminal result come as batches.
- `waitForLocal` (`local.go:71`) reads exactly one `LocalResult` and turns it into one `localMsg`. The handler re-arms the wait with `waitForLocal(msg.load)` (`model.go:2563`). So each result is one Update and one re-render.
- Progress phases go through `applyRepoProgress` (`repo_progress.go:43`). Phase ranks are: favorites = max(1, current), cache = 1, everything else = 2, terminal = 3. Lower ranks and anything after the terminal result are rejected.

**There is no throttling or debouncing anywhere.** The only `tea.Tick`s in the package are the fleet warmup (`model.go:633`, `fleet_resume.go:206`) and SSH background (`ssh_discovery.go:467`).

**Sizes:** also one message per target. `waitForSize` (`size.go:129`) produces one `sizeMsg` each, handled by `updateSize` and then `applySizeResult` (`size.go:32`, `:139`).
- The manager is `diskusage.NewManager(cache, 2)`, i.e. 2 workers (`cli/app.go:124-126`).
- The cache file is `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/dev/sizes-v1.json` with a **10-minute TTL**.
- `Manager.Measure` (`internal/diskusage/manager.go:47-68`) checks the cache before scanning unless `force` is set. But cache hits are still delivered one message per target, through the same 2-worker pipeline, and only after the local stream has closed. There is no pre-seed of sizes before or during the repo stream.
- `Cache.Save()` runs at the end of each load (`manager.go:174`).

**Caches in use:**
- `repos-v1.json` (Status and LastActivity only) is used before the fresh scan, as the `"cache"` phase.
- `sizes-v1.json` is used during the size load, after the repo stream.
- Herdr/runtime results are **not cached**. `rt.List` runs once per local load.
- LATEST (`LastActivity`) is cached in `repos-v1.json`.

**No periodic polling:** there is no repeated Herdr refresh for REPOS. Runtime status updates only on an explicit reload. The fleet Herdr refresh in `fleet_herdr.go` is separate.

## 4. Cursor preservation

The cursor follows **repo identity**, not the row index:
- `Model.Update` (`repo_topology.go:44-76`) handles `localMsg`, `reposMsg`, `reloadMsg`, `sizeMsg`, `configMsg`, `triesMsg` and `noteListMsg`. Before handling, it captures `focus = currentToken()` and `path = repoFocusPath()`. Afterwards it calls `restoreRepoFocus(focus, path)`.
- `applyLocalResult` (`local.go:86-124`) and `applyRepoProgress` (`repo_progress.go:60-78`) also capture and restore internally.
- The token key is `repoItemKey` (`list_actions.go:164`): `repoKey` (CommonDir, or Path if there is none) plus the worktree path for child rows. `selectToken` (`list_actions.go:258`) searches `visibleRepoItems()` for that key.
- If that fails, `restoreRepoFocus` (`repo_progress.go:91`) matches by path. If both fail, `setAt` clamps the old index.
- Effect: the highlighted repo keeps the highlight but moves to its new index. The visible window is centered on the cursor (`window()`, `view.go:285-297`: `from = m.at() - h/2`), so the whole visible page scrolls as the selected repo moves.
- `focusStartupRepo` can also move the cursor once, when the startup repo first appears.

## 5. Config knobs

From `/Users/zhouhanru/Documents/David/Program/dev-cli/internal/config/config.go`:
- `[tui.repos]` (`RepoTable`, `:257-266`):
  - `columns`: the default is `repo, branch, git, size, live, latest, worktrees, tasks` (`:270`)
  - `sort`: one of activity, latest, name, git, size, tasks. Validated at `:589`; the doc comment at `:263` leaves out `size`. Default `activity` via `EffectiveRepoSort` (`:283`)
  - `reverse` (bool)
- `[tui.fleet] background_refresh` and `[tui.ssh] background_refresh` (`:248-255`) apply to FLEET and SSH only.
- `[tui.remote.prs]` covers PR paging and TTL.

**There are no knobs** for REPOS background refresh, size scanning (worker count and 10-minute TTL are hard-coded in `app.go:125-126`), Herdr polling, or debouncing. Sort and columns can be hot-reloaded through `ConfigUpdate.RepoSort` and `RepoReverse` (`cli/tui.go:743-745`, `model.go:2882`).

## 6. Existing tests

In `internal/tui`:
- `tui_test.go`: `TestReposSortWorkInFlightFirst` (2131), `TestRepoLatestSortAndReverse` (3313), `TestOCyclesRepoSort` (3334), `TestSizeStreamUpdatesRepoAndTryRowsWithoutBlockingInitialRender` (1844), `TestSharedLocalLoadPublishesEachViewWithoutWaitingForOthers` (3377), `TestRepoViewShowsLiveRuntimeExplicitly` (3163)
- `dashboard_improvements_test.go`: `TestRepoProgressRejectsLateCacheAndKeepsFocus` (58), `TestRepoFilterPreservesChildFocusAcrossProgress` (380)
- `repo_favorite_test.go`: `TestRepoFavoritesStayAboveEverySortAndRespectFilter` (26), `TestRepoFavoriteMutationKeepsFocusAndSurvivesOlderSnapshots` (51), `TestFavoriteProgressDeduplicatesAliasesAndKeepsFocus` (153), `TestFavoriteProgressDoesNotLoseCacheOrDowngradeRows` (183)
- `table_test.go`: `TestColumnSortCyclesPreservingFocusAndUnknownLast` (17)
- `startup_repo_test.go`: `TestStartupRepoFocusKeepsOrderingAndUserChoice` (35), `TestStartupRepoFocusHandlesEitherArrivalOrder` (60)
- `readiness_internal_test.go`: `TestLocalCycleCloseStartsSizesAfterOneViewWasSuperseded` (110)

In `internal/cli` (loader side):
- `tui_repo_load_test.go`: `TestTUILocalLoaderPublishesCacheBeforeDiscoveryCandidates` (89), `TestTUILocalLoaderFavoriteBeforeDiscoveryAndRuntimeRejoin` (134), `TestTUIRepoStreamRuntimeRejoinsWhileOrdinarySlotsAreBusy` (242), plus favorite admission and cancellation tests
- `dashboard_improvements_test.go`: `TestStreamingReposPublishGitBeforeRuntimeAndCacheCompletedRows` (22)
- `tui_load_test.go`: `TestTUILocalLoaderSharesInputsAndPublishesViewsIndependently` (17)

The existing tests check that the selected repo keeps focus across updates and that late results are rejected. None of them checks that row order stays stable while enrichment, runtime or size results arrive.

- **Size:** this only reorders anything when the sort is `size` or a SIZE column sort is active. Then every `sizeMsg` moves one row.

## 3. How async results arrive

**Local stream:** results come **per repo** for discovery, enrichment and runtime. Favorites, cache and the terminal result come as batches.
- `waitForLocal` (`local.go:71`) reads exactly one `LocalResult` and turns it into one `localMsg`. The handler re-arms the wait with `waitForLocal(msg.load)` (`model.go:2563`). So each result is one Update and one re-render.
- Progress phases go through `applyRepoProgress` (`repo_progress.go:43`). Phase ranks are: favorites = max(1, current), cache = 1, everything else = 2, terminal = 3. Lower ranks and anything after the terminal result are rejected.

**There is no throttling or debouncing anywhere.** The only `tea.Tick`s in the package are the fleet warmup (`model.go:633`, `fleet_resume.go:206`) and SSH background (`ssh_discovery.go:467`).

**Sizes:** also one message per target. `waitForSize` (`size.go:129`) produces one `sizeMsg` each, handled by `updateSize` and then `applySizeResult` (`size.go:32`, `:139`).
- The manager is `diskusage.NewManager(cache, 2)`, i.e. 2 workers (`cli/app.go:124-126`).
- The cache file is `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/dev/sizes-v1.json` with a **10-minute TTL**.
- `Manager.Measure` (`internal/diskusage/manager.go:47-68`) checks the cache before scanning unless `force` is set. But cache hits are still delivered one message per target, through the same 2-worker pipeline, and only after the local stream has closed. There is no pre-seed of sizes before or during the repo stream.
- `Cache.Save()` runs at the end of each load (`manager.go:174`).

**Caches in use:**
- `repos-v1.json` (Status and LastActivity only) is used before the fresh scan, as the `"cache"` phase.
- `sizes-v1.json` is used during the size load, after the repo stream.
- Herdr/runtime results are **not cached**. `rt.List` runs once per local load.
- LATEST (`LastActivity`) is cached in `repos-v1.json`.

**No periodic polling:** there is no repeated Herdr refresh for REPOS. Runtime status updates only on an explicit reload. The fleet Herdr refresh in `fleet_herdr.go` is separate.

## 4. Cursor preservation

The cursor follows **repo identity**, not the row index:
- `Model.Update` (`repo_topology.go:44-76`) handles `localMsg`, `reposMsg`, `reloadMsg`, `sizeMsg`, `configMsg`, `triesMsg` and `noteListMsg`. Before handling, it captures `focus = currentToken()` and `path = repoFocusPath()`. Afterwards it calls `restoreRepoFocus(focus, path)`.
- `applyLocalResult` (`local.go:86-124`) and `applyRepoProgress` (`repo_progress.go:60-78`) also capture and restore internally.
- The token key is `repoItemKey` (`list_actions.go:164`): `repoKey` (CommonDir, or Path if there is none) plus the worktree path for child rows. `selectToken` (`list_actions.go:258`) searches `visibleRepoItems()` for that key.
- If that fails, `restoreRepoFocus` (`repo_progress.go:91`) matches by path. If both fail, `setAt` clamps the old index.
- Effect: the highlighted repo keeps the highlight but moves to its new index. The visible window is centered on the cursor (`window()`, `view.go:285-297`: `from = m.at() - h/2`), so the whole visible page scrolls as the selected repo moves.
- `focusStartupRepo` can also move the cursor once, when the startup repo first appears.

## 5. Config knobs

From `/Users/zhouhanru/Documents/David/Program/dev-cli/internal/config/config.go`:
- `[tui.repos]` (`RepoTable`, `:257-266`):
  - `columns`: the default is `repo, branch, git, size, live, latest, worktrees, tasks` (`:270`)
  - `sort`: one of activity, latest, name, git, size, tasks. Validated at `:589`; the doc comment at `:263` leaves out `size`. Default `activity` via `EffectiveRepoSort` (`:283`)
  - `reverse` (bool)
- `[tui.fleet] background_refresh` and `[tui.ssh] background_refresh` (`:248-255`) apply to FLEET and SSH only.
- `[tui.remote.prs]` covers PR paging and TTL.

**There are no knobs** for REPOS background refresh, size scanning (worker count and 10-minute TTL are hard-coded in `app.go:125-126`), Herdr polling, or debouncing. Sort and columns can be hot-reloaded through `ConfigUpdate.RepoSort` and `RepoReverse` (`cli/tui.go:743-745`, `model.go:2882`).

## 6. Existing tests

In `internal/tui`:
- `tui_test.go`: `TestReposSortWorkInFlightFirst` (2131), `TestRepoLatestSortAndReverse` (3313), `TestOCyclesRepoSort` (3334), `TestSizeStreamUpdatesRepoAndTryRowsWithoutBlockingInitialRender` (1844), `TestSharedLocalLoadPublishesEachViewWithoutWaitingForOthers` (3377), `TestRepoViewShowsLiveRuntimeExplicitly` (3163)
- `dashboard_improvements_test.go`: `TestRepoProgressRejectsLateCacheAndKeepsFocus` (58), `TestRepoFilterPreservesChildFocusAcrossProgress` (380)
- `repo_favorite_test.go`: `TestRepoFavoritesStayAboveEverySortAndRespectFilter` (26), `TestRepoFavoriteMutationKeepsFocusAndSurvivesOlderSnapshots` (51), `TestFavoriteProgressDeduplicatesAliasesAndKeepsFocus` (153), `TestFavoriteProgressDoesNotLoseCacheOrDowngradeRows` (183)
- `table_test.go`: `TestColumnSortCyclesPreservingFocusAndUnknownLast` (17)
- `startup_repo_test.go`: `TestStartupRepoFocusKeepsOrderingAndUserChoice` (35), `TestStartupRepoFocusHandlesEitherArrivalOrder` (60)
- `readiness_internal_test.go`: `TestLocalCycleCloseStartsSizesAfterOneViewWasSuperseded` (110)

In `internal/cli` (loader side):
- `tui_repo_load_test.go`: `TestTUILocalLoaderPublishesCacheBeforeDiscoveryCandidates` (89), `TestTUILocalLoaderFavoriteBeforeDiscoveryAndRuntimeRejoin` (134), `TestTUIRepoStreamRuntimeRejoinsWhileOrdinarySlotsAreBusy` (242), plus favorite admission and cancellation tests
- `dashboard_improvements_test.go`: `TestStreamingReposPublishGitBeforeRuntimeAndCacheCompletedRows` (22)
- `tui_load_test.go`: `TestTUILocalLoaderSharesInputsAndPublishesViewsIndependently` (17)

The existing tests check that the selected repo keeps focus across updates and that late results are rejected. None of them checks that row order stays stable while enrichment, runtime or size results arrive.</result>

func gitSortCell(s gitx.Status) sortCell {
	return numberCell(int64(s.Conflicted), int64(s.Changed), int64(s.Ahead+s.Behind), int64(s.Ahead), int64(s.Behind))

func boolNumber(b bool) int64 {
	if b {
		return 1
	}
	return 0
}
func applyColumnSort[T any](m Model, rows []T, project func(T, string) sortCell) []T {
	s := m.activeTableSort()
	if s.column == "" {
		return rows
	}
	slices.SortStableFunc(rows, func(a, b T) int {
		x, y := project(a, s.column), project(b, s.column)
		if x.known != y.known {
			if x.known {
				return -1
			}
			return 1
		}
		if !x.known {
			return 0
		}
		c := 0
		if x.nums != nil || y.nums != nil {
			c = slices.Compare(x.nums, y.nums)
		} else {
			c = cmp.Compare(x.text, y.text)
		}
		if s.descending {
			return -c
		}
		return c
	})
	return rows
}
func taskCell(r inventory.Row, key string) sortCell {
	if r.Task == nil {
		return sortCell{}
	}
	switch key {
	case "task":
		return textCell(r.Task.Title())
	case "state":
		return textCell(string(r.Task.State))
	case "repo":
		return textCell(r.Task.Repo)
	case "branch":
		return textCell(r.Task.Branch)
	case "age":
		return timeCell(r.Task.Updated)
	case "next":
		return textCell(r.Task.Next)
	case "git":
		if r.StatusErr != nil {
			return sortCell{}
		}
		return gitSortCell(r.Status)
	}
	return sortCell{}
}

func TestTUILocalLoaderSharesInputsAndPublishesViewsIndependently(t *testing.T) {
	app := &App{trace: perftrace.New(64)}
	loader := &tuiLocalLoader{app: app}
	var taskReads, runtimeReads, repoReads atomic.Int32
	taskStarted, runtimeStarted, repoStarted := make(chan struct{}), make(chan struct{}), make(chan struct{})
	tracked := []*task.Task{{ID: "task-a", Name: "task-a", Repo: "api", RepoPath: "/src/api"}}
	discovered := []repo.Repo{{Name: "api", Path: "/src/api", RealPath: "/src/api"}}
	loader.listTasks = func() ([]*task.Task, error) {
		taskReads.Add(1)
		close(taskStarted)
		return tracked, nil
	}
	loader.loadRuntime = func(context.Context) (tuiRuntimeSnapshot, error) {
		runtimeReads.Add(1)
		close(runtimeStarted)
		return tuiRuntimeSnapshot{runtime: runtime.None{}}, nil
	}
	loader.discoverRepos = func(context.Context) ([]repo.Repo, error) {
		repoReads.Add(1)
		close(repoStarted)
		return discovered, nil
	}
	repoGate, tryGate := make(chan struct{}), make(chan struct{})
	var taskLimiter, repoLimiter *inventory.Limiter
	loader.collectTasks = func(_ context.Context, got []*task.Task, _ tuiRuntimeSnapshot,
		limiter *inventory.Limiter) ([]inventory.Row, error) {
		taskLimiter = limiter
		return []inventory.Row{{Task: got[0], Checkout: got[0].RepoPath}}, nil
	}
	loader.collectRepos = func(_ context.Context, gotTasks []*task.Task, gotRepos []repo.Repo,
		_ tuiRuntimeSnapshot, limiter *inventory.Limiter) ([]tui.RepoRow, error) {
		<-repoGate
		repoLimiter = limiter
		if len(gotTasks) != 1 || len(gotRepos) != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("shared inputs tasks=%d repos=%d", len(gotTasks), len(gotRepos))
		}
		return []tui.RepoRow{{Repo: gotRepos[0], Tasks: gotTasks}}, nil
	}
	loader.collectTries = func(context.Context, bool, tuiRuntimeSnapshot) ([]tui.TryRow, error) {
		<-tryGate
		return []tui.TryRow{{}}, nil
	}

	load := loader.Start(context.Background(), tui.LocalLoadRequest{
		TasksGeneration: 1, ReposGeneration: 2, TriesGeneration: 3,
	})
	first := receiveLocalResult(t, load.Results)
	if first.View != tui.ViewTasks || first.Generation != 1 || len(first.Tasks) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("first result = %+v", first)
	}
	<-taskStarted
	<-runtimeStarted
	<-repoStarted
	if taskReads.Load() != 1 || runtimeReads.Load() != 1 || repoReads.Load() != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("input reads tasks=%d runtime=%d repos=%d", taskReads.Load(), runtimeReads.Load(), repoReads.Load())
	}

	close(repoGate)
	second := receiveLocalResult(t, load.Results)
	if second.View != tui.ViewRepos || second.Generation != 2 || len(second.Repos) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("second result = %+v", second)
	}
	if taskLimiter == nil || taskLimiter != repoLimiter {
		t.Fatal("TASKS and REPOS did not share one enrichment limiter")

package repo

import (
	"context"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestPresentationCacheRequiresMatchingScopeAndValidRows(t *testing.T) {
	path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "repos-v1.json")
	root := t.TempDir()
	repos, state := filepath.Join(root, "repos"), filepath.Join(root, "state")
	key := SnapshotKey([]string{repos}, state)
	snapshot := Snapshot{Fingerprint: key, ObservedAt: time.Now(), Rows: []CachedRow{{Repo: Repo{Name: "demo", Path: filepath.Join(repos, "demo")}}}}
	if err := WriteSnapshot(path, snapshot); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := ReadSnapshot(context.Background(), path, key); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := ReadSnapshot(context.Background(), path, SnapshotKey([]string{filepath.Join(root, "other")}, state)); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("wrong scope accepted")
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte("{broken"), 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := ReadSnapshot(context.Background(), path, key); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("malformed cache accepted")
	}
}

# Changelog

All notable changes to this project are documented in this file.

The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/), and releases use [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).

## [Unreleased]

## [0.3.4] - 2026-10-31

### Added

- REPOS repository favorites: `f` or the action menu toggles a durable catalog
  favorite, shown with `★` and grouped first without overriding filters or the
  ordering within each group. Current-host favorites within discovery scope
  appear provisionally even without a cache and receive priority enrichment;
  ordinary discovery continues and unavailable targets retain their favorite.
- Bilingual research on human/agent work items, proposal triage and cross-devbox
  handoffs compares Markdown, hosted trackers, td/Sidecar, Beads/Dolt and Herdr.
  Task guidance distinguishes durable outcomes from change streams and agent
  sessions, with staged trial criteria before adding dev integrations.

### Changed

- Dashboard list filtering accepts `Ctrl+O` directly: it keeps the current query
  and selection, leaves input, and opens the normal action menu without an
  intermediate Enter. Closing the menu returns to the filtered list; existing
  action readiness and active-clone guards still apply.
- Lowercase `f` is now reserved for REPOS favorites. Custom tools previously
  bound to it must move to another available key, such as uppercase `F`.

package cli

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io/fs"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sync"

	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/perftrace"

const tuiTraceEnv = "DEV_TUI_TRACE"

func traceFromEnvironment() (*perftrace.Recorder, string, error) {
	path := os.Getenv(tuiTraceEnv)
	if path == "" {
		return nil, "", nil
	}
	if !filepath.IsAbs(path) {
		return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("%s must name an absolute, non-existing file", tuiTraceEnv)
	}
	path = filepath.Clean(path)
	if _, err := os.Lstat(path); err == nil {
		return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("%s already exists: %s", tuiTraceEnv, path)
	} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
		return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("inspect %s: %w", tuiTraceEnv, err)
	}
	parent, err := os.Stat(filepath.Dir(path))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("inspect %s parent: %w", tuiTraceEnv, err)
	}
	if !parent.IsDir() {
		return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("%s parent is not a directory", tuiTraceEnv)
	}
	return perftrace.New(perftrace.DefaultLimit), path, nil
}

// finishTrace freezes background producers before writing the one-shot trace.
// It is safe to call both immediately after Bubble Tea and from Execute's defer.
func (a *App) finishTrace() {
	if a == nil {
		return
	}
	if a.traceOnce == nil {
		a.traceOnce = &sync.Once{}
	}
	a.traceOnce.Do(func() {
		if a.trace == nil || a.tracePath == "" || !a.traceTUI {
			return
		}
		if err := perftrace.WriteNew(a.tracePath, a.trace.Freeze()); err != nil {
			writer := a.Err
			if writer == nil {
				writer = os.Stderr
			}
			fmt.Fprintf(writer, "dev: warning: performance trace: %v\n", err)
		}
	})

func (m Model) tableHeader() tableHeader { return m.headerFrom(m.renderRawList()) }

	if m.snippetsActive() {

func (m Model) decorateTable(raw string) string {
	h := m.headerFrom(raw)
	order := m.activeTableSort()
	if order.column == "" || len(h.columns) == 0 {
		return raw
	}
	line := h.text
	for _, c := range h.columns {
		if c.key == order.column {
			arrow := "↑"
			if order.descending {
				arrow = "↓"
			}
			label := fitCell(strings.ToUpper(c.key)+" "+arrow, c.to-c.from)
			line = line[:c.from] + label + line[c.to:]
			break
		}
	}
	lines := strings.Split(raw, "\n")
	lines[h.line] = styleHeader.Render(line)
	return strings.Join(lines, "\n")
}

dashboard. Git synchronization diagnostics retain a category, exit code, bounded
redacted output and a next step; old receipts cannot recover discarded reasons.
Retries require a new preview. Authentication, fetch and rebase are never
silently performed as error recovery. See [local triage](local-triage.md).


## Progressive loading, searchable actions and yearly activity

REPOS reads a dated presentation cache and seeds in-scope favorites, then
publishes discovery and Git observations incrementally. A slow runtime does not
hold back repository rows. Enter/`o` validates the selected target without waiting
for the full inventory; pending/cached observations still cannot authorize
lifecycle, cleanup or batch actions. The new-repo wizard is an independent entry
point and retains its final mutation checks. Only complete discovery removes
missing ordinary rows; unavailable favorites retain their catalog preference.
Failures retain stale/unknown evidence. `r` remains local refresh;
`dev self cache clear repos` removes the snapshot, not favorites.
SIZE retains its separate cache.

Ctrl+O menus and submenus support `/` filtering, arrows and Enter; Escape clears
search before closing. `H` displays saved stats, then automatically backfills the
selected repository's full local Git history. Unchanged refs reuse a checkpoint.
Calendar years run oldest first, with wheel/arrows, PgUp/PgDn and Home/End
scrolling; narrow screens split into week segments. `r` refreshes and `b` forces
backfill without fetching. Git activity is still a 20-minute estimate per
non-merge commit.

The REPOS/SKILLS action menu opens the independent
[Skills management wizard](skills-management.md) for scopes, selection, checks
and reviewed mutations; it is not another dashboard tab.


### Local loading measurement

A 60-repository isolated fixture, three runs per case on macOS with Go 1.26.4,
measured the following medians. These are trace acceptance times, not terminal
rasterization; all live Git reads still finish in the background.

| Case | First repository data | Complete local snapshot |
|---|---:|---:|
| Previous dashboard | 3,896 ms | 3,896 ms |
| New, no presentation cache | 14 ms | 3,911 ms |
| New, presentation cache | 15 ms | 2,819 ms |

The first display no longer waits for a full scan. Full-scan duration remains
sensitive to filesystem/process load; this change does not claim cached Git
facts are current. Recovery details are loaded for the focused repository, and
completed rows become available while other repositories are still loading.

## SSH connection view

The eighth tab keeps one machine row, with Space expanding its SSH profiles.
Configured connections come first, ordered by the most recent local `dev ssh
connect` or dashboard connection attempt; unrecorded profiles follow by alias.
CONNECTION, ENDPOINT, SOURCES, CHECK and USED share aligned display widths.
Narrow terminals hide supplementary columns; details retain full source names,

func TestRepoProgressRejectsLateCacheAndKeepsFocus(t *testing.T) {
	m := New(Actions{}, nil, nil)
	m.view = ViewRepos
	m.width = 100
	m.height = 30
	generation := m.beginViewLoad(ViewRepos, loadInitial)
	a := RepoRow{Repo: repo.Repo{Name: "a", Path: "/a"}, Pending: "cached"}
	b := RepoRow{Repo: repo.Repo{Name: "b", Path: "/b"}, Pending: "loading"}
	m, _ = m.applyLocalResult(LocalResult{View: ViewRepos, Generation: generation, Phase: "cache", Repos: []RepoRow{a}, Valid: true})
	token := m.currentToken()
	m, _ = m.applyLocalResult(LocalResult{View: ViewRepos, Generation: generation, Phase: "discovery", Repos: []RepoRow{b}, Valid: true})
	if token != m.currentToken() {
		t.Fatal("partial result moved focus")
	}
	var accepted bool
	m, accepted = m.applyLocalResult(LocalResult{View: ViewRepos, Generation: generation, Phase: "cache", Repos: []RepoRow{{}}, Valid: true})
	if accepted {
		t.Fatal("late cache accepted")
	}
	a.Pending = ""
	m, _ = m.applyLocalResult(LocalResult{View: ViewRepos, Generation: generation, Repos: []RepoRow{a}, Valid: true})
	if len(m.repos) != 1 || m.repos[0].Pending != "" {
		t.Fatal(m.repos)
	}
	m, accepted = m.applyLocalResult(LocalResult{View: ViewRepos, Generation: generation, Phase: "enrichment", Repos: []RepoRow{b}, Valid: true})
	if accepted {
		t.Fatal("post-completion patch accepted")
	}
}

func TestTUILocalLoaderPublishesCacheBeforeDiscoveryCandidates(t *testing.T) {
	r := gittest.New(t)
	discovered := loaderDiscoveredRepo(t, r.Root)
	app := loaderTestApp(t, r.Root)
	snapshot := repo.Snapshot{Fingerprint: repo.SnapshotKey(app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), app.Cfg.StateDir()), ObservedAt: time.Now(),
		Rows: []repo.CachedRow{{Repo: discovered}}}
	if err := repo.WriteSnapshot(filepath.Join(cacheRoot(), "repos-v1.json"), snapshot); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	loader := &tuiLocalLoader{app: app,
		loadRuntime: func(context.Context) (tuiRuntimeSnapshot, error) {
			return tuiRuntimeSnapshot{runtime: runtime.None{}}, nil
		},
		collectTries: func(context.Context, bool, tuiRuntimeSnapshot) ([]tui.TryRow, error) { return nil, nil },
	}
	load := loader.Start(t.Context(), tui.LocalLoadRequest{ReposGeneration: 1})
	first, sawDiscovery := true, false
	for result := range load.Results {
		if result.View != tui.ViewRepos {
			continue
		}
		if first && result.Phase != "cache" {
			t.Fatalf("discovery overtook cached presentation: %q", result.Phase)
		}
		first = false
		sawDiscovery = sawDiscovery || result.Phase == "discovery"
	}
	if first || !sawDiscovery {
		t.Fatal("loader did not publish cache and discovery")
	}
}

// Cache is derived latency state, never a source of truth.
type Cache struct {
	Path  string
	TTL   time.Duration
	Clock func() time.Time

	mu      sync.Mutex
	loaded  bool
	entries map[string]Usage
}

// NewCache returns a lazy-loading cache.
func NewCache(path string, ttl time.Duration) *Cache {
	return &Cache{Path: path, TTL: ttl, Clock: time.Now}
}

// Get returns only fresh, structurally valid measurements.
func (c *Cache) Get(target Target) (Usage, bool, error) {
	if c == nil {
		return Usage{}, false, nil
	}
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	if err := c.loadLocked(); err != nil {
		return Usage{}, false, err
	}
	usage, ok := c.entries[targetKey(target)]
	if !ok || (c.TTL > 0 && c.now().Sub(usage.MeasuredAt) > c.TTL) {
		return Usage{}, false, nil
	}
	if err := usage.Validate(); err != nil {
		return Usage{}, false, fmt.Errorf("cached disk usage: %w", err)
	}
	usage = cloneUsage(usage)
	usage.Cached = true
	return usage, true, nil
}

// Set updates memory. Call Save once after a measurement batch to avoid one
// filesystem rewrite per row.
func (c *Cache) Set(target Target, usage Usage) error {
	if c == nil {
		return nil
	}
	usage.Cached = false
	if err := usage.Validate(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	if err := c.loadLocked(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
